jobs.title: Commercial Project Specialist - Insulins & Established Products Franchise - VIE Contract
jobs.desc:
Commercial Project Specialist - Insulins & Established Products Franchise - VIE Contract

• Location: Germany, Berlin
• Target start date: 01/03/2027

iMove, the Sanofi VIE Program, is available to citizens of the European Economic Area (EU + Norway, Liechtenstein and Iceland) aged between 18 and 28.

PLEASE NOTE that since this program is primarily an international development program, candidates cannot apply to a VIE assignment in their own country of citizenship.

PLEASE NOTE that applications that are only submitted in French cannot be considered by our non-French speaking partners at Sanofi worldwide. Therefore, only applications that are submitted in English will be considered. Please make sure to apply with your personal email address.

About the job

As Commercial Project Specialist - Insulins & Established Products Franchise VIE within our Commercial management team, you’ll will play an active role in supporting the franchise’s strategic priorities and driving business excellence across a diverse pharmaceutical portfolio. Working closely with franchise leadership and cross-functional teams, you will contribute to both the development and execution of key business initiatives.

Join the team transforming how healthcare is delivered for chronic and specialty conditions worldwide. In General Medicines, you’ll help drive meaningful outcomes in diabetes, transplant, and immunology - with the scale and urgency patients deserve.

Ready to get started?

About Sanofi

We’re an R&D-driven, AI-powered biopharma company committed to improving people’s lives and delivering compelling growth. Our deep understanding of the immune system – and innovative pipeline – enables us to invent medicines and vaccines that treat and protect millions of people around the world. Together, we chase the miracles of science to improve people’s lives.

Main responsibilities:

• Business Performance Management: Support regular business reviews, key performance indicator (KPI) monitoring, sales performance analysis and identification of improvement opportunities.
• Strategic Project Execution: Coordinate and follow up on key franchise initiatives, ensuring timely execution and alignment across functions.
• Insulin Launch Readiness: Contribute to launch preparation of new services and devices, market intelligence, customer service initiatives and commercial readiness activities.
• Portfolio Management: Support portfolio assessments, business planning, forecasting and commercial optimization initiatives.
• Commercial Excellence & Go-to-Market: Contribute to the implementation and evaluation of new customer engagement and commercial models.
• Cross-functional Business Coordination: Facilitate collaboration between Marketing, Sales, Finance, Trade, M&S and other functions to support business priorities.
• Management Support & Business Insights: Prepare business analyses, presentations, decision-making materials and recommendations for franchise leadership.

About you

Experience:

• Previous internship experience in pharmaceuticals, healthcare, consulting, marketing or business management is an advantage.
• Initial exposure to project management, business analytics or commercial operations is desirable.

Soft and technical skills:

• Strong analytical and organizational skills.
• Proactive, pragmatic and hands-on mindset.
• Ability to manage multiple priorities and deliver results.
• Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
• Curiosity, adaptability and willingness to learn.
• Comfortable working independently and in cross-functional teams.
• Strong proficiency in Excel and PowerPoint.
• Analytical and problem-solving capabilities.
• Knowledge of Power BI or other analytical tools is an advantage.
• Interest in digital tools, AI and business transformation.

Education:

• Master’s degree in Business Administration, Economics, Management, Healthcare Management, Life Sciences or a related field.

Languages:

• Fluent English (verbal & written).
• German is strong advantage.

Why choose us?

• Be part of a pioneering biopharma company where patient insights shape drug development.
• Work at the forefront of AI-powered science that accelerates discovery and improves outcomes.
• Collaborate beyond your expertise, sparking new ideas with diverse, multidisciplinary teams.
• Help shape the future of care for chronic and complex conditions like aT1D, Type 2 diabetes, transplant, and cardiovascular disease.
• Drive meaningful impact at global scale: our medicines reach more than 100 million people each year.
• Contribute to innovations that improve outcomes, relieve pressure on healthcare systems, and expand access worldwide.
• Join a team that’s not just transforming treatment - but asking what’s next, and making it real.

iMove is a unique program tailored for European youth interested in challenging themselves with meaningful assignments across the globe. At Sanofi we have a strong ambition to invest in young talents who will drive the success of Sanofi tomorrow.
Sanofi’s Work Abroad Program, iMove, offers jobs-assignments with actual responsibilities and a perspective to grow. We provide those opportunities in various functions such as: marketing, finance, regulatory, supply chain, clinical trials, production, etc. and in more than 40 countries. Sanofi unites people who are passionate about solving healthcare needs across the world. Joining our iMove Work Abroad Program is a unique opportunity to make a difference through your work.

#LI-EUR

Pursue progress, discover extraordinary
Better is out there. Better medications, better outcomes, better science. But progress doesn’t happen without people – people from different backgrounds, in different locations, doing different roles, all united by one thing: a desire to make miracles happen. So, let’s be those people.

• Lieu : Lyon

À propos du poste

En tant que stagiaire au sein de notre équipe Nouveau produit et innovation, tu participeras aux activités opérationnelles du laboratoire d'innovation en assurant la communication, l'animation collaborative et le support aux équipes. Prêt à commencer ?

Prêt(e) à développer tes compétences tout en participant à l’avenir de la santé ? Chez Sanofi, tu auras la liberté d’apprendre, de poser des questions et de donner vie à tes idées, le tout soutenu par des mentors inspirants et des équipes collaboratives.

À propos de Sanofi
Sanofi est une entreprise biopharmaceutique qui innove en R&D et exploite l'IA à grande échelle pour améliorer la vie des gens et créer de la croissance à long terme. Notre compréhension approfondie du système immunitaire – et notre pipeline innovant – nous permet d’inventer des médicaments et des vaccins qui traitent et protègent des millions de personnes dans le monde entier. Ensemble, nous poursuivons les miracles de la science pour améliorer la vie des gens.

Principales responsabilités :

• Participer à la réalisation du programme évènementiel et au plan de communication interne des laboratoires d'innovation
• Apporter votre support à la réalisation de preuves de concept pour les projets d'automatisation sans code et à faible code des laboratoires
• Prendre part à la maintenance des lieux et outils des laboratoires d’innovation et accompagner les équipes dans leur utilisation
• Contribuer à l’animation et au suivi des ateliers d’intelligence collective et interagir avec des coachs internes et externes

À propos de toi

• Compétences techniques et relationnelles : aisance relationnelle, esprit d’équipe, rigueur. Connaissance des outils Microsoft Power Platform. Expérience en design thinking et management de l’innovation
• Éducation : bac+5 en management de l’innovation
• Langues : anglais courant

Pourquoi nous choisir ?

• Lance ta carrière dans une entreprise qui investit en toi, et te donne les moyens de réinventer ce qui est possible.

• Construis ton avenir avec les outils les plus récents, l’innovation digitale et un apprentissage continu pour toujours garder une longueur d’avance.

• Évolue dans une entreprise engagée où ta voix compte et où ton travail améliore la vie de millions de personnes.

• Épanouis-toi dans des environnements inclusifs et flexibles qui soutiennent ton bien-être personnel et professionnel.

• Une gratification de stage attractive.
• Selon votre site de rattachement, l’accès à un restaurant d’entreprise avec une participation de Sanofi.
• Notre processus de recrutement a été pensé pour être rapide et efficace. Si votre candidature est retenue, vous recevrez un appel de notre recruteur.se pour un premier échange téléphonique puis pour rencontrer rapidement le ou la manager.

Toujours Progresser. Découvrir l’Extraordinaire.

Rejoins Sanofi et entre dans une nouvelle ère de la science – où ton parcours peut être aussi transformateur que le travail que nous accomplissons. Nous investissons en toi pour que tu ailles plus loin, tu accélères ta réflexion et tu accomplisses ce qui n’a jamais été fait auparavant. Tu contribueras à repousser les limites, à bousculer les conventions et à concevoir des solutions plus intelligentes pour les communautés que nous servons. Prêt·e à poursuivre les miracles de la science et à améliorer la vie des gens ? Poursuivons le progrès et découvrons l’extraordinaire – ensemble.

Chez Sanofi, nous croyons dans l’égalité des chances, sans distinction de race, de couleur, d’ascendance, de religion, de sexe, d’origine, d’orientation sexuelle, d’âge, de citoyenneté, d’état civil, de handicap, d’identité de genre ou de tout autre critère protégé par la loi.

jobs.title: Services - Full-Time Analyst, Ireland - Dublin, 2027 (2026 Summer Intern Converts Only)
jobs.desc:
You're the brains behind our work.

You’re ready to bring your knowledge from the classroom to the workplace, and Citi wants to help you get there. Whether it’s honing your skills or building your network, we know that success comes with growth. Our program equips you with the knowledge and training you need to play a valuable role on your team and establish a long-term career here. At Citi, we value internal mobility—career growth is not a question of if, but when.

What is Services?

Citi’s Services organization plays a crucial role in supporting institutional clients through a wide range of innovative solutions, enabling them to navigate complex financial landscapes. Our business provides integrated cash management and trade finance solutions to help multinational corporations, financial institutions, and public sector organizations optimize liquidity, working capital, and streamline transactions globally. Our business also delivers custody, fund administration, collateral management, and performance analytics, helping asset managers, institutional investors, and financial institutions efficiently manage and safeguard assets. With our global reach, including presence in over 90 countries, cutting-edge technology, and client-first approach, we provide seamless solutions that drive business success in an evolving financial world.

In this rapidly evolving landscape, we are increasingly leveraging advanced analytics and artificial intelligence (AI) to enhance our offerings, improve efficiency, and provide deeper insights to our clients. This includes utilizing AI-powered tools for predictive analytics, automation of routine tasks, and generating actionable insights from vast datasets to inform strategic decisions across our services portfolio.

We provide you with the knowledge and skills you need to succeed.

The Services Analyst Program is a 2.5-year rotational program designed to help you build a broad skill set and accelerate your career growth by gaining exposure to multiple areas within the Services business. The program begins in July and starts with an intensive training and orientation to give you a strong foundation in both the business and Citi's culture. You will then rotate across two different roles within Services based on your interests and the needs of the business, gaining meaningful experience through hands-on projects and exposure to senior leaders.

Your time here will look something like this:

• Conduct market research to assess industry trends and the impact of macroeconomic factors.

• Develop materials that support business development, product commercialization, and revenue growth, identifying opportunities where data-driven insights and AI capabilities can add value. • Assist with process optimization initiatives to enhance efficiency and mitigate risk, potentially exploring how AI/ML tools can automate tasks or improve decision-making. Evaluate the effectiveness of AI-powered automation in improving operational workflows and reducing manual effort.

• Analyze client data to identify opportunities and improve service offerings, leveraging various analytical techniques, including interpreting insights derived from advanced analytical models. You will be exposed to how AI models are used to segment clients, predict behaviors, and personalize service delivery.

• Prepare reports and presentations for internal stakeholders and senior leadership, effectively communicating complex data analysis and potentially insights from AI-driven tools. Clearly articulate the implications and benefits of AI-generated insights for business strategies.

• Participate in networking events, training sessions, and leadership discussions to strengthen your personal and professional development.

We want to hear from you if…

• You are a graduating between 2025 and Summer 2027 and are on track to achieve or have already achieved a 2.1 (or equivalent).

• You have strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

• You are proficient in Microsoft Excel (e.g., data analysis, lookups, basic modeling) and have working knowledge of PowerPoint and Outlook. Exposure to analytical platforms or an eagerness to learn about AI-specific tools (e.g., natural language processing applications, machine learning dashboards) will be beneficial.

• You have an interest in financial services and a drive to learn how technology, including AI, is transforming the industry. Demonstrated curiosity about how AI is being leveraged for efficiency, client experience, and risk management is key.

Who we think will be a great fit…

We’re looking for motivated individuals who are eager to start their careers at a global organization, tend to think strategically, have an innovative approach to business, and value diversity as much as we do. We know that anyone—not just those with business degrees—can have a knack for business, so we’re open to all disciplines. We’ll also be looking for:

• Strong interpersonal and relationship-building skills.

• Excellent communication skills.

• A high level of accuracy, time management, and attention to detail, including a proactive interest in understanding AI methodologies and their application in real-world business scenarios.

• Solid organizational skills and ability to work autonomously – self-starter.

• A high level of personal integrity, commitment to excellence, and a strong desire to learn.

• Resilience to thrive in a fast-paced, high-volume environment.

• A sense of urgency and the ability to execute quickly and efficiently.

Your future at Citi

During the program, you will have access to mentorship, career development sessions, and networking opportunities with senior leaders and professionals across Citi. This experience is designed to provide you with a strong foundation to launch a long-term career within the firm, preparing you for a future…

If you’re curious, collaborative and ready to dive deep into meaningful work, you’ll fit right in.

From reporting to strategic planning, your work will have a direct impact on Delivery Hero's ability to innovate, expand, and deliver outstanding experiences to our customers.

• Process and manage internal tickets on cost center adjustments and maintenance.

• Help resolve intercompany recharge differences.

• Document existing controlling workflows to streamline onboarding and keep the department consistent.

Qualifications

• Current enrolment in a university degree program, ideally a Master's in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration or a related field.

• Availability to work up to 20 hours per week during the semester.

• MS Office skills, especially Excel, and an affinity for finance tools.

• Interest in processes and finance.

• Organised and well-structured, able to switch between diverse tasks in a fast-paced environment.

• Good communication skills in English.

Nice to have

• Experience with any reporting tool.

Additional Information
Ensuring you and all our Heroes are looked after, happy, and healthy is always on the menu. Because if you’re in good shape, then we’re in good shape.

jobs.title: Automation Graduate
jobs.desc:
• Location: Waterford, Ireland
• Start Date: 1 September 2027
• Duration: 23 months | Two 8-month rotations, and 7-month
• Working Model: on-site
• Working Hours: Full-time
• Salary: €41,600 gross per annum
• Assessment Centre: January 2027 | In person, Waterford

Your opportunity at Sanofi
Ready to turn your academic knowledge into real-world experience?
Join Sanofi, a global biopharmaceutical company, through our 23-month Graduate Programme in Waterford. Explore three different functions, gain hands-on industry experience and develop the skills to shape your future career.

The future of manufacturing is digital, connected, and data-driven. Through our Automation Graduate Programme, you'll gain hands-on experience with industry-leading technologies, support impactful automation projects, and help shape the next generation of pharmaceutical manufacturing at Sanofi Waterford.

One programme. Three rotations. A world of experience.
Why explore just one area when you could experience three?
Our structured Graduate Programme takes you through two 8-month rotations, and 7-month, providing exposure to different functions, meaningful projects and opportunities to learn from experienced professionals.

Your rotation journey

Rotation 1: Automation & Controls Operations | Months 1–8
Start your journey in Automation & Controls Operations, where you'll gain a strong foundation in the systems that support safe, efficient and reliable manufacturing processes. You'll work alongside automation engineers and operations teams to understand how digital technologies enable the production of life-changing medicines.

• Support the maintenance and troubleshooting of PLC, SCADA and HMI systems used across manufacturing operations.
• Gain hands-on experience with GMP-compliant computerised systems while supporting day-to-day automation activities in mAbs and Lyophilisation production areas.
• Assist with system documentation, continuous improvement initiatives and the implementation of automation updates to enhance operational performance.

Rotation 2: Engineering Projects & Digital Systems | Months 9–16
Continue your development within Engineering Projects & Digital Systems, where you'll contribute to automation projects and digital transformation initiatives that support the future of manufacturing at Sanofi.

• Support the delivery of automation and digital projects from planning through implementation.
• Work with MES and LIMS platforms, assisting with system support, configuration activities and lifecycle management.
• Collaborate with Engineering, Automation, IT and Digital teams to develop solutions that improve operational efficiency and data visibility.

Rotation 3: Advanced Automation & Digital Innovation | Months 17–23
In your final rotation, you'll build on your experience by taking ownership of more complex initiatives and working closely with cross-functional teams to deliver innovative solutions.

• Lead or support automation projects focused on line digitalisation, process optimisation and Industry 4.0 technologies.
• Contribute to digital and data analytics initiatives in partnership with functions such as Supply Chain, Manufacturing Science & Technology (MSAT) or Operations.
• Develop project management, stakeholder engagement and problem-solving skills while delivering improvements that support business and manufacturing objectives.

Your development focus
Throughout the programme, you'll develop knowledge and practical skills to support your future career in Automation, Digital Engineering and Advanced Manufacturing. You will gain hands-on experience working with automation systems, digital technologies and cross-functional project teams while building the technical and professional capabilities needed to succeed in a modern biopharmaceutical manufacturing environment.

• Develop expertise in automation and control systems, including PLCs, SCADA, HMI platforms, and GMP-compliant computerised systems.
• Build strong project management, problem-solving, collaboration and stakeholder engagement skills through cross-functional assignments and project work.
• Gain practical experience in digital transformation, data-driven decision-making, system lifecycle management, and the implementation of Industry 4.0 technologies within a regulated manufacturing environment.

Your growth, our commitment
Your development is at the heart of our programme. Here's what you can look forward to:

• Three diverse rotations: Explore different functions and build a broader understanding of the business.
• Dedicated cross-functional mentor: Receive guidance from an assigned mentor, with monthly check-ins throughout the programme.
• A buddy in every rotation: Get practical, day-to-day support as you settle into each new team.
• Hands-on training: Learn directly from experienced colleagues and develop skills through practical experience and training opportunities.

Who we're looking for
We're looking for curious, motivated graduates who are eager to learn, collaborate and explore new opportunities.

To be eligible, you'll need to:

• Have graduated within the past two years or be due to graduate before 1 September 2027.
• Hold a minimum 2.1 primary degree or a Master's degree in Automation Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Electronic Engineering, Mechatronics, Computer Engineering, Software Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related engineering or technology discipline.
• Have full, unrestricted right to work in Ireland.

Essential skills:

• Strong interest in automation, digital technologies, and advanced manufacturing environments.
• Basic understanding of industrial automation systems, control systems, programming, or computer networking.
• Strong problem-solving and analytical skills, with the ability to troubleshoot technical issues systematically.
• Effective communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work successfully in cross-functional teams.

jobs.title: Software Engineer Intern
jobs.desc:
HI, WE’RE BACK MARKET.

We’re here to help make tech reliable, affordable, and better than new. We're a global marketplace for refurbished devices, helping lower our collective environmental impact by providing trustworthy, affordable tech with 92% less carbon emissions than new.

Yep, you read that right. Turns out refurbished tech is way better for the planet than new. In fact, With every device purchased on Back Market, our positive impact on the planet grows. From our Customer Care representatives to our software engineer, every individual at Back Market cuts the planet — and consumers — a break. Our mission is simple: to do more with what we already have.

Are you ready to join us?

We are looking for multiple Software Engineer Interns to join some of Back Market’s Engineering teams in the Paris office. Depending on your interests and experience, you may contribute to projects across our product, platform, data, payments, shipping, customer experience or circularity teams.

Our Engineering teams build the technology that powers Back Market, from customer-facing experiences to the internal services used by our teams and partners. You will work alongside software engineers, product managers, designers, data analysts and other stakeholders in a collaborative and international environment.

With support from experienced engineers, you will learn how we design, develop, test, deploy and monitor reliable software in a production environment.




WHAT YOU WILL DO IN THIS ROLE

As a Software Engineer Intern, you will learn and contribute alongside experienced engineers:

 - Assist with developing and improving features, with guidance from your team.

 - Participate in writing clean, maintainable and well-tested code.

 - Contribute to code reviews and technical discussions to learn from the team.

 - Help investigate bugs and support the resolution of technical issues.

 - Participate in testing, deployment and monitoring activities.

 - Work with product, design, data and operations teams to understand requirements.

 - Assist with maintaining technical documentation and sharing knowledge.

 - Explore different technologies and gradually build your skills across the software development lifecycle.

You will join an agile "build it and run it" environment, where teams take part in building, launching, monitoring and improving the products and services they own. Your level of responsibility will grow throughout the internship, with regular guidance and feedback from your team.




OUR TECH ENVIRONMENT 💻

The technologies you use will depend on the team you join. Our engineering environment may include:

 - Backend: Python, FastAPI, SQLAlchemy, Celery, Golang and Django

 - Frontend: Vue.js, TypeScript, Nuxt and Revolve, our design system

 - Data and messaging: PostgreSQL, Redis, Kafka, RabbitMQ and BigQuery

 - Infrastructure and delivery: Google Cloud Platform, Kubernetes, Docker, Datadog, Argo CD, CircleCI and GitHub

You do not need experience with all of these technologies. We are more interested in your technical foundations, curiosity and willingness to learn.




YOU ARE IN THE RIGHT PLACE IF: ⭐

 - Mandatory! Currently enrolled in your final year of an Engineering School/University Master's degree and your university can provide an internship agreement - already based in France

 - You have knowledge of basic coding languages and ideally Python and have basic programming experience (other internships, github, personal or student projects).

 - You have knowledge of databases and operating systems

 - You have the ability to learn new software and technologies quickly, being curious about the coding environment you’ll evolve in.

 - You are detail-oriented and have the desire and ability to work in a team in an international environment.

 - You are fluent in English - French is a plus.

 - You are looking for a 6 month, full-time role (35h/week), internship from March/April 2026

 - You are authorized to work in France (EU Nationality or in possession of valid student visa/work permit).

 


ABOUT THE INTERNSHIP: ℹ️

 - Starting date: March/April 2027

 - Duration: 6 months

 - Full-time internship (35h/week - Monday to Friday)

 - Location: Paris, France

 


RECRUITMENT PROCESS: 📅

 - Video-call Interview with the Campus Recruitment Manager (30min)

 - Video-call Technical fit interview : Live coding + open talk (60 min) with 2 senior engineers

 - Video-call Team fit interview with 1 other member from the team (30 min)

 


WHY SHOULD YOU JOIN US ? ✌🏼

At Back Market, we’re committed to hiring and supporting diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives — it’s one of the reasons we’re such a high-scoring certified B Corp company (93.2).

No matter your role and seniority level, you’ll enjoy impact-driven work with hands-on career development in an innovative, driven, and fast-paced environment — with benefits to match, like:

- A mission driven work environment where your day to day makes an impact on the planet. Seriously.

- Hybrid work environment, with 2 remote days a week and 1 remote work week per quarter, plus 3 flex days.

- Employee Resource Groups, including mentorship programs, comprehensive accessibility policies, and cultural competency training.

At Back Market, we strive to create a workplace that embodies the world we’re trying to change. We’ve embedded our diversity, equity, and inclusion principles into our DNA — from dedicated staff to employee resource groups to our company values.

We know that the perfect background for a role doesn’t mean the perfect fit — we encourage you to apply for a role even if you think you may not have all the qualifications.

If reasonable accommodations are needed for the interview process, please do not hesitate to discuss this with the Talent Acquisition Team.

jobs.desc:
• Location: Waterford
• Start date: January 2027
• Duration: 6-8 months
• Work Model: Hybrid – minimum 3 days per week on site. Depending on project, training and business needs, additional on-site presence may sometimes be required.

About the job
As a Quality Excellence Intern, you’ll get hands-on experience supporting projects that help strengthen quality culture and continuous improvement across the site.
You’ll work alongside experienced colleagues on a variety of quality-focused activities, from improvement projects and quality systems to training and audit readiness. This is an opportunity to build your project, communication and problem-solving skills while gaining an understanding of how quality is embedded within a healthcare manufacturing environment.
You don’t need to already be a quality expert. We’re looking for someone who is curious, proactive and keen to learn, who enjoys getting involved in projects and working with different people across the organisation.

Ready to grow your skills while helping shape the future of healthcare? At Sanofi, you’ll be empowered to learn, ask questions, and bring your ideas to life – all while supported by inspiring mentors and collaborative teams.

Main responsibilities:

• Support quality and continuous improvement projects, helping to coordinate activities, track actions and keep projects moving forward.
• Contribute to quality issue investigations by supporting root cause analysis and helping identify appropriate improvement and preventive actions.
• Work with production and other teams across the site to support process improvements and quality initiatives.
• Support the introduction and use of new quality systems, tools and ways of working.
• Help monitor the effectiveness of improvement initiatives, maintain project records and prepare progress updates for stakeholders.
• Support quality culture, training and audit-readiness activities, including helping to coordinate sessions and follow up on agreed actions.
• Prepare presentations, trackers, reports and other project materials, while proactively looking for opportunities to support the wider team.

About you
To excel in this role you will need to have:

• Be a current university student who will return to university after completing the internship.
• An interest in quality, continuous improvement and project work. Your field of study can be broad, and a specific scientific or quality-related discipline is not required.
• A proactive approach and willingness to take initiative, get involved and look for ways to contribute.
• Good communication skills and confidence working with and reaching out to different people across a team or organisation.
• Good organisation skills and the ability to manage tasks, follow up on actions and work on different activities.
• Comfortable using Microsoft Office tools such as PowerPoint, Excel and Word, and willing to learn new systems and tools.
• A collaborative mindset, curiosity and willingness to ask questions, learn and seek support when needed.

About Sanofi
We’re an R&D-driven, AI-powered biopharma company committed to improving people’s lives and delivering compelling growth. Our deep understanding of the immune system – and innovative pipeline – enables us to invent medicines and vaccines that treat and protect millions of people around the world. Together, we chase the miracles of science to improve people’s lives.

Why choose us?

• Stretch your skills through apprenticeships, internships, graduate programs, and international experiences that grow with you.
• Learn from inspiring mentors and collaborative teams while contributing to real projects that shape the future of healthcare.

jobs.title: Security Associate - Internship
jobs.desc:
HEALTH CAN’T WAIT. 

Not for symptoms to get worse. Not for a six‑month appointment. Not for a system to catch up. But that’s exactly how healthcare works today. You wait, until you can’t.

Alan exists to end the wait.

Health is a universal right, and we believe this right can only become real when it’s coupled with prevention. We need to stop treating health as something we repair and start treating it as something we build, every day. It’s not solely a question of willpower. It’s the healthcare system itself that needs to work for everyone, in a sustainable way.

So we are building the new standard in prevention insurance. Alan is the first company that integrates insurance, prevention, and care into a single, acclaimed user experience.

We are on an incredible journey to build a global leading company, with a unique culture https://alan.com/en/careers. We already partner with 40K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members, and have reached €800M+ in ARR.

Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 1000+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond.

⭐ SECURITY ASSOCIATE INTERNSHIP ⭐

Six-month end-of-studies internship in Paris.

Looking for an end-of-studies internship where you do real cybersecurity work, not a side project nobody uses? Alan protects the health data of more than 1M members, and keeping it safe is part of everyday work here.

You join the Security team as a full member for six months. Topics span from compliance and certifications to vulnerabilities, detection and incident response, and you have room to pick the ones where you can have the most impact. A dedicated coach guides you and supervises your thesis. The goal at the end is a full-time job at Alan.



⭐ DETAILED MISSIONS ⭐

Alan is opening new countries, and each one brings more audits, certifications and customer security reviews. Possible topics span from governance and compliance to hands-on technical work. You won't do all of them: with your coach, you choose the ones that matter most for Alan and for you.

 - Governance, risk and compliance: ISO 27001 and HDS (French health data hosting) certifications, statutory IT audit, customer security reviews, risk management

 - Vulnerability management: triage reports and scanner findings, drive fixes with engineering teams, improve our tooling

 - Detection and response: write detection rules, investigate alerts, support the team on incidents

 - Build: technical projects you own from framing to adoption. Past projects: an internal pentest for an audit, code scanning and remediation, an HDS internal audit, tooling proofs of concept

 - Automate what repeats, so the team spends its time where the risk is



⭐ KEY OUTCOMES ⭐

By the end of the internship, you will have:

 - Owned a recurring security campaign end to end and left it cheaper for the next round

 - Shipped one technical project to real users

 - Written your end-of-studies thesis on a real security subject

 - Worked with engineers and senior people across the company



⭐ PROFILE & COMPETENCIES ⭐

 - End of studies: engineering or security track, looking for a six-month internship

 - Security foundations: solid basics in security and IT, and you can apply them to a concrete case

 - You code: Python at least, and you automate the repetitive part

 - Curiosity: you dig into topics you don't master yet, and you are curious about compliance, not only offensive security

 - Risk sense: you know not every risk is equal, and some trade-offs are worth taking

 - Collaboration: you work with engineers, not against them, and look for solutions that work for both sides

 - Clear communication: structured and written, in English (French is a plus)

 - Bonus: CTFs, personal security projects, a previous security internship, cloud or SaaS experience




🙌   PERKS & BENEFITS https://alan.com/about/life-at-alan/a/perks


At Alan, we believe that being in good health is a basic need, and it starts with our employees. This is why Alaners are provided with a stimulating environment and perks ensuring they are happy, efficient and spend only high-quality time with co-workers. 
Therefore, we offer:

 - Flexible Office. Amazing office space at our HQ, sponsored co-working hubs or a full-remote experience with home office equipment sponsorship, we want you to live where you’re the happiest.

 - All the tools you need. Top of the range equipment: Macbook Pro, keyboard, laptop stand, monitor, and Bose noise-canceling headphones.

 - Flexible vacation policy and flexible working hours. Organize your time as you wish.

 - Transport. Country-specific commuter benefits.

 - Learning & Training opportunities. A highly flexible Training policy free books and budget to attend and speak at conferences if the opportunity arises.

 - Personal growth through coaching: At Alan, coaching isn't just a perk - it's core to who we are. Every Alaner is paired with a dedicated coach from day one, who helps maximize their impact, nurture engagement, and navigate Alan's values to develop their full potential. jobs.title: AI Content & Knowledge Manager Intern
jobs.desc:
HI, WE’RE BACK MARKET.

We’re here to help make tech reliable, affordable, and better than new. We're a global marketplace for refurbished devices, helping lower our collective environmental impact by providing trustworthy, affordable tech with 92% less carbon emissions than new.

Yep, you read that right. Turns out refurbished tech is way better for the planet than new. In fact, With every device purchased on Back Market, our positive impact on the planet grows. From our Customer Care representatives to our software engineer, every individual at Back Market cuts the planet — and consumers — a break. Our mission is simple: to do more with what we already have.

Are you ready to join us?




JOB DESCRIPTION:

Back Market is building AI-powered customer care experiences through Fin, its customer-facing AI Agent. Fin helps customers with pre-sales questions, delivery tracking, and technical troubleshooting.

As an AI Quality & Evaluation Intern, you will work with the QA Lead to monitor Fin’s performance, review conversations, identify recurring issues, and help improve the quality evaluation process. You will collaborate with content, product, data, and engineering teams to turn your findings into concrete improvements.




YOUR MISSION (IF YOU ACCEPT IT): 🥇

 - Operate and improve quality monitors and scorecards covering accuracy, policy compliance, connector use, escalation quality, tone, hallucinations, and unsupported claims.

 - Review flagged and unflagged conversations to identify false positives, false negatives, and recurring defects.

 - Prepare the weekly quality review by summarizing key findings, risks, and root causes.

 - Analyse Fin’s performance across markets, languages, use cases, and rollout phases.

 - Monitor handovers to human agents and customer satisfaction signals.

 - Track corrective actions, owners, and validation status.

 - Improve the documentation and versioning of Fin’s evaluation framework.

 - Share clear, actionable feedback with product, engineering, content, and data teams.




YOU ARE IN THE RIGHT PLACE IF: ⭐

 - You are completing a Master 2 degree in Data Science, Applied Mathematics, Statistics, or another engineering discipline.

 - You have strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

 - You are comfortable working with data and investigating anomalies.

 - You are interested in generative AI, machine learning, or LLM evaluation.

 - You can structure and communicate findings clearly in English and French.

 - You are curious, detail-oriented, pragmatic, and comfortable investigating ambiguous problems.

 - You can distinguish facts, hypotheses, and open questions.



BONUS POINT : Experience with LLM evaluation, prompt evaluation, conversational AI, or human-in-the-loop systems is a plus. French is helpful but not required.






ABOUT THE INTERNSHIP:

 - Start date: January 2027

 - Duration : 6 months

 - Full-time internship (35h/week)

 - Location : Paris (France)
   
   


RECRUITMENT PROCESS: 📅

 - Skill fit interview and live case study with a team member (30min)

 - Video-call Interview with the Talent Acquisition Specialist (30 min)

 - Cultural fit interview with the manager (30min)
   
   


WHY SHOULD YOU JOIN US ? ✌🏼

At Back Market, we’re committed to hiring and supporting diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives — it’s one of the reasons we’re such a high-scoring certified B Corp company (93.2).

No matter your role and seniority level, you’ll enjoy impact-driven work with hands-on career development in an innovative, driven, and fast-paced environment — with benefits to match, like:

- A mission driven work environment where your day to day makes an impact on the planet. Seriously.

- Hybrid work environment, with 2 remote days a week and 1 remote work week per quarter, plus 3 flex days.

- Employee Resource Groups, including mentorship programs, comprehensive accessibility policies, and cultural competency training.

At Back Market, we strive to create a workplace that embodies the world we’re trying to change. We’ve embedded our diversity, equity, and inclusion principles into our DNA — from dedicated staff to employee resource groups to our company values.

We know that the perfect background for a role doesn’t mean the perfect fit — we encourage you to apply for a role even if you think you may not have all the qualifications.

If reasonable accommodations are needed for the interview process, please do not hesitate to discuss this with the Talent Acquisition Team.

jobs.title: Junior Berater (d/m/w) Wealth Management Select Berlin
jobs.desc:
Job Description:

Über den Bereich

In der Privatkundenbank bündelt die Deutsche Bank ihre Expertise im Privatkundengeschäft in einem Geschäftsbereich – mit den Marken Deutsche Bank und Postbank als Marktführer in Deutschland und einem globalen Netzwerk, die das Geschäft der Bank mit vermögenden Kund*innen weltweit sowie mit Privatkund*innen und kleinen bis mittelgroßen Unternehmen umfasst.

In ihrem Heimatmarkt Deutschland wie auch international bietet die Privatkundenbank ihren Kund*innen hochwertige Finanzdienstleistungen aus einer Hand – von umfassenden Angeboten für Privatkund*innen über die Betreuung anspruchsvoller Unternehmer und ihrer Familien bis hin zu Lösungen für kleinere und mittelgroße Unternehmen in wichtigen Märkten der Eurozone.

Die Privatkundenbank ist neben der Unternehmensbank, der Investmentbank und dem Asset Management mit ihrem Vermögensverwalter DWS eine der vier Geschäftsbereiche des Deutsche-Bank-Konzerns. Die Deutsche Bank ist Deutschlands führende Bank mit globalem Netzwerk und fest verwurzelt in Europa.

Wir führen unser Wealth Management in Deutschland mit dem Ziel, die unangefochtene, führende Privatkundenbank in Deutschland zu sein. Wir sind Marktführer und sehen aufgrund unserer ausgezeichneten Stellung im Markt, der großen Qualität unserer Mitarbeiter*innen und unserer breiten Angebotspalette weiteres Wachstumspotential. Zusätzlich stärken wir die Zusammenarbeit mit unserer Unternehmensbank, um Unternehmer*innen – privat und geschäftlich – zu bedienen. Für außerordentlich vermögende Kund*innen treten wir dabei mit der im Markt führenden Marke Deutsche Bank Wealth Management auf.

Wir streben eine „Culture of Excellence“ an.

Ihre Aufgaben

• Sie betreuen ein eigenes Kundenportfolio im Segment Wealth Management mit dem Auftrag, durch das Führen von strukturierten Strategiegesprächen Kundenbedarfe und -potentiale systematisch zu erkennen und zu heben, sowie insbesondere einfache Bedarfe abschließend zu beraten bzw. bei erkennbaren komplexen Bedarfen an erfahrene Wealth Management Berater oder Spezialisten weiterzuleiten.
• Ihre Kernkompetenz ist die Vermögensanlageberatung. Im Sinne des ganzheitlichen Ansatzes umfasst dies die Beratung zu sämtlichen (Wertpapier-)Produkten und Dienstleistungen in Wealth Management.
• Mit Ihren verkäuferischen Fähigkeiten führen Sie die Beratung der Kunden bei einfachen Bedarfen erfolgreich zum Abschluss bzw. leiten Kunden für komplexere Beratung an erfahrene Wealth Management Berater oder Spezialisten weiter.
• Sie beraten ganzheitlich, die regulatorischen Anforderungen an das Wertpapiergeschäft berücksichtigend und führen strukturierte Strategiegespräche unter Einsatz der zur Verfügung stehenden Tools, Prozesse und Hilfsmittel.
• Die Entwicklung Ihrer Kompetenz am Kunden bringen Sie durch regelmäßigen Austausch und eine enge Zusammenarbeit mit erfahrenen Teammitgliedern und z.B. mittels Tandemgesprächen voran. Sie pflegen die persönliche Kundenbeziehung mit dem Ziel der langfristigen Kundenbindung.

Ihre Fähigkeiten und Erfahrungen

• Sie haben eine Ausbildung zur Bankkauffrau/zum Bankkaufmann, eine weiterführende Ausbildung und/oder Studium sind wünschenswert.
• Sie haben Beratungserfahrung im Privatkundenbereich und bringen umfassende Kenntnisse zum MiFiD-konformen Beratungsprozess und zum Produktspektrum ein.
• Ihre fundierten Kenntnisse im Bereich Investments inkl. Finanzmarktentwicklungen sowie Ihre guten Erfahrungen in der Terminvereinbarung zur Ausschöpfung der Kundenpotentiale ergänzen Ihre Kompetenzen.
• Sie zeigen ein hohes Maß an Kunden- und Serviceorientierung und Ihr Auftreten den Kunden gegenüber ist souverän, kompetent und freundlich.
• Sie haben Freude daran im Team zu arbeiten, zeigen Eigeninitiative und Durchsetzungsvermögen.

Was wir Ihnen bieten

Wir bieten eine breite Palette von Leistungen, die all Ihre beruflichen und persönlichen Bedürfnisse abdecken.

• Emotional ausgeglichen
Eine positive Haltung hilft uns, die Herausforderungen des Alltags zu meistern – beruflich wie privat. Profitieren Sie von Angeboten wie Beratung in schwierigen Lebenssituationen und Angeboten zur Förderung mentaler Gesundheit.
• Körperlich fit
Mit Angeboten zur Aufrechterhaltung Ihrer persönlichen Gesundheit und einem förderlichen beruflichen Umfeld hilft Ihnen die Bank, körperlich fit zu bleiben. Profitieren Sie von Angeboten wie umfangreichen Check-up Untersuchungen, Impfangeboten und Beratung zur gesunden Lebensführung.
• Sozial vernetzt
Der Austausch mit anderen eröffnet uns neue Perspektiven, bringt uns beruflich wie persönlich voran und stärkt unser Selbstvertrauen und Wohlbefinden. Profitieren Sie von Angeboten wie Unterstützung durch den pme Familienservice, das FitnessCenter Job, flexible Arbeitszeitmodelle (bspw. Teilzeit, Jobtandem, hybrides Arbeiten) sowie einer umfangreichen Kultur der Vielfalt, Chancengleichheit und Teilhabe.
• Finanziell abgesichert
Die Bank sichert Sie nicht nur während Ihrer aktiven Karriere, sondern auch für die Zukunft finanziell ab und unterstützt Ihre Flexibilität sowie Mobilität – egal ob privat oder beruflich. Profitieren Sie von Angeboten wie Beitragsplänen für Altersvorsorge, Bankdienstleistungen für Mitarbeiter*innen, Firmenfahrrad oder dem Deutschlandticket.

Da die Benefits je nach Standort geringfügig variieren, gehen Sie bitte bei konkreten Fragen auf Ihre Recruiterin zu.

Die Stelle wird in Voll- und in Teilzeit angeboten.

Bei Fragen zum Rekrutierungsprozess steht Ihnen Melanie Klopsch gerne zur Verfügung.
Kontakt Melanie Klopsch, Telefonnummer: 030 3407-2861

We strive for a culture in which we are empowered to excel together every day. This includes acting responsibly, thinking commercially, taking initiative and working collaboratively.
Together we share and celebrate the successes of our people. Together we are Deutsche Bank Group.

We welcome applications from all people and promote a positive, fair and inclusive work environment.

jobs.title: Data Associate - Internship (6 months, flexible start)
jobs.desc:
HEALTH CAN’T WAIT. 

Not for symptoms to get worse. Not for a six‑month appointment. Not for a system to catch up. But that’s exactly how healthcare works today. You wait, until you can’t.

Alan exists to end the wait.

Health is a universal right, and we believe this right can only become real when it’s coupled with prevention. We need to stop treating health as something we repair and start treating it as something we build, every day. It’s not solely a question of willpower. It’s the healthcare system itself that needs to work for everyone, in a sustainable way.

So we are building the new standard in prevention insurance. Alan is the first company that integrates insurance, prevention, and care into a single, acclaimed user experience.

We are on an incredible journey to build a global leading company, with a unique culture https://alan.com/en/careers. We already partner with 40K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members, and have reached €800M+ in ARR.

Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 1000+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond.


⭐ DATA ASSOCIATE ⭐

The position is a six-month end-of-studies internship in Paris, with a flexible start date.

Data Associates join a product or business crew and work alongside a senior member of the Data team, taking on a real share of their projects. It is the same work as the rest of the team, building insights and data-powered products that help our members stay healthy, at a pace and scope designed for someone starting out.

Our team is full stack: each member sits in a crew next to engineers, product builders and designers and leads projects from A to Z, covering analytics, engineering and science. We mainly use SQL, Python, dbt, Airflow and Metabase, and Claude Code and AI agents are part of our daily workflow. Want to know more? Read our vision for the Data team https://medium.com/alan/vision-for-a-data-team-2eae845b8052 (old one, but still relevant) and how our Data team is re-inventing its craft with AI https://medium.com/alan/re-inventing-our-craft-how-alans-data-team-is-shaping-its-future-with-ai-e8d73d095ece.

This is our first generation of Data Associates, and we built the program with one goal: you join us full-time at the end of it. That decision is made at your 5-month review.



⭐ DETAILED MISSIONS ⭐

What you work on depends on the crew you join, something that is decided once you start your internship, but your six months will mix:

 - Answering real business or product questions: framing the problem, digging into the data and turning what you find into a recommendation your crew acts on.

 - Building tools people use: a dbt model, a dashboard a team uses every week, a tool powered by AI. You would ship them end to end, with your senior counterpart supporting you on key steps

 - Growing with the Data community: joining our main rituals (retros, insights sharing sessions, on-call shifts), and later helping us recruit the next generation of Data Associates

You won’t be alone: from day one, you will benefit from a senior Alaner from the Data team to work with at the office and a coach from the Data team as well.



⭐ IS IT YOU WE'RE LOOKING FOR? ⭐

Please note that for this internship, you need to:

 - Be based in Paris, France

 - Work from our Valmy office at least 4 days a week

 - Be in the final year of your studies (engineering or business, with a strong quantitative track), with an internship agreement from your school

You would be a great fit if most of this sounds like you:

 - You want a career in Data, across the whole spectrum. If what you want above everything else is to build ML models, a research internship is probably a better fit for you

 - You have used SQL and Python, at school, in an internship or on a side project. We teach you the rest

 - Analytical sense and rigor: you ask the right question before you reach for the data, and you can tell a real signal from noise

 - Business & product sense: you care about what the numbers change for members and for the company

 - Effective communication: you explain a result simply, in writing and out loud

 - High agency and growth mindset: facing an unfamiliar problem, your first instinct is to find a way through, and you ask for feedback to grow

 - AI fluency: you already build with AI tools, and you are curious about where they fall short

 - You are fluent in English (no need to speak French!)

But above all, we are looking for high potential and curiosity: make sure to show us this when you apply! Everything else is a bonus.

For this internship, we are hiring at the A2 level of our salary grid https://alan.com/en/careers/a/salary-equity.

jobs.title: Junior SDR – Sales Development Representative (m/w/d) – SME / KMU | Berlin (Hybrid)
jobs.desc:
Junior SDR – Sales Development Representative (m/w/d) – SME / KMU | Berlin (Hybrid)

Unbefristet · Vollzeit · Start zum 1. Januar 2027 oder früher · Berlin, 2 Tage pro Woche im Office (Montag und Donnerstag)

Starte deine Sales-Karriere als Junior SDR bei Pennylane in Berlin. Du sprichst mit Unternehmen, die bereits Interesse an unserer Software gezeigt haben, klärst ihren Bedarf und vereinbarst passende Demo-Termine für unsere Account Executives – ohne Kaltakquise. Mit Sales Academy, Buddy und Shadowing lernst du den SaaS-Vertrieb von Grund auf.

Du willst Arbeit, die etwas bewirkt – an einem Produkt, das bald Millionen von Unternehmer:innen in Europa helfen könnte?

Du arbeitest am besten in einer Kultur, die auf Vertrauen und Eigenverantwortung setzt?

Dann könnte Pennylane genau der richtige Ort für dich sein.



Unsere Vision

Unser Ziel ist es, die beliebteste Finanzmanagement-Software für KMU in Europa zu werden.

Wir befreien Unternehmer:innen von zeitraubenden Aufgaben in Buchhaltung und Finanzen und geben ihnen die Finanzkennzahlen an die Hand, die sie für die besten Entscheidungen für ihr Unternehmen brauchen.

Gleichzeitig helfen wir Steuerkanzleien, weniger Zeit mit repetitiven Aufgaben und mehr Zeit mit der Beratung ihrer Mandant:innen zu verbringen.



Kontext

Pennylane ist eines der am schnellsten wachsenden Fintechs in Frankreich – und wir sind im zweiten Jahr unserer Expansion nach Deutschland, mit unserem deutschen Team in Berlin.

In 6 Jahren unseres Bestehens haben wir Folgendes erreicht:

 - 💻 Wir haben uns als bahnbrechende Buchhaltungs- und Finanzsoftware für kleine Unternehmen und ihre Steuerberater:innen bekannt gemacht.

 - 💰 Wir haben insgesamt 400 Millionen Euro eingesammelt, unter anderem von Sequoia, dem berühmten Fonds aus dem Silicon Valley, der früh in Unternehmen wie Google, Facebook, Airbnb, Stripe, PayPal und viele mehr investiert hat.

 - 👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Wir sind von 7 Mitbegründern auf mehr als 1.100 zufriedene Pennylaner angewachsen: Wir gelten heute als einer der besten Arbeitsplätze in Frankreich (auch remote), mit einer Bewertung von 4,6/5 auf Glassdoor.

 - 🌍 Wir haben ein internationales Umfeld mit mehr als 25 Nationalitäten aufgebaut, mit einer starken Remote-freundlichen Kultur, in der 30 % der Mitarbeitenden bereits aus allen Teilen Europas arbeiten.

 - 🤝 Wir haben das Vertrauen tausender Kund:innen und Steuerkanzleien gewonnen – mit herausragenden Bewertungen.

 - 🚀 Bereits mehr als 1.300.000 KMU (kleine und mittlere Unternehmen) und über 6.500 Steuerkanzleien nutzen Pennylane in Frankreich!



Warum ist diese Rolle so wichtig für uns?

Das SDR-Team ist entscheidend dafür, wie wir neue Kund:innen gewinnen.

Als erstes Glied in unserer Sales-Kette prüfen SDRs, welche Anfragen gut zu Pennylane passen, und machen daraus Gesprächstermine – und legen damit die Basis für den Erfolg des gesamten Teams.

Wir erhalten täglich viele Inbound-Anfragen von Unternehmen, die Pennylane kennenlernen möchten. Genau mit diesen arbeitest du – 100 % Inbound-Vertrieb, Kaltakquise (Outbound) gibt es in dieser Rolle nicht.

 - Du fasst per Telefon, E-Mail und LinkedIn nach und reaktivierst Leads, die abgetaucht sind oder einen Termin verpasst haben

 - Du übergibst qualifizierte Leads mit einem klaren Briefing an den Account Executive und hältst Salesforce sauber – Lead-Status, Notizen, nächste Schritte

 - Du teilst Erkenntnisse zu Lead-Qualität und -Quellen mit dem Marketing

Dein Erfolg zeigt sich daran, wie viele passende Gesprächstermine du vereinbarst, wie viele davon stattfinden und aus wie vielen konkrete Verkaufschancen entstehen.

 - Mit wachsender Erfahrung übernimmst du zusätzliche Verantwortung: eigene Projekte, die Pflege unserer Wissensdatenbank (Notion) und die Unterstützung neuer Kolleg:innen

jobs.desc:
CONTEXTE


Tu rejoindras l’équipe Brand, au sein du pôle Communication & Contenu de Pennylane.

Caroline, responsable de nos réseaux sociaux, t’accompagnera au quotidien. Le stage sera entièrement dédié à ces sujets, avec LinkedIn comme canal prioritaire, ainsi qu’Instagram et TikTok.

Tu seras en lien avec l’ensemble des équipes pour identifier les sujets, les expertises et les temps forts à valoriser. Ce travail s’inscrit dans un contexte de forte croissance : Pennylane est passée de 100 M€ à 250 M€ d’ARR en un an. À l’échelle de l’entreprise, les réseaux sociaux représentent 15 à 20 publications par semaine, et Pennylane organise près de 250 événements par an : autant de sujets et d’occasions à faire vivre sur nos réseaux.




MISSIONS PRINCIPALES


1. Calendrier éditorial & publication

 - Proposer des sujets et des angles de publication en lien avec les actualités et les priorités de Pennylane, en échangeant avec les équipes concernées pour identifier les expertises et les temps forts à valoriser

 - Participer à la planification et à la publication des contenus

 - Participer à la captation et au montage de vidéos, selon les besoins

 - Recueillir les informations auprès des équipes internes pour rendre les contenus précis et accessibles

 - Assurer une veille sur les tendances, les formats et les usages des réseaux sociaux

 - Partager des recommandations pour améliorer les contenus et leur diffusion

jobs.title: APAC Marketing Operations Intern (Japanese required)
jobs.desc:
HI, WE’RE BACK MARKET.

We’re here to help make tech reliable, affordable, and better than new. We're a global marketplace for refurbished devices, helping lower our collective environmental impact by providing trustworthy, affordable tech with 92% less carbon emissions than new.

Yep, you read that right. Turns out refurbished tech is way better for the planet than new. In fact, With every device purchased on Back Market, our positive impact on the planet grows. From our Customer Care representatives to our software engineer, every individual at Back Market cuts the planet — and consumers — a break. Our mission is simple: to do more with what we already have.

Are you ready to join us?




JOB DESCRIPTION:

The APAC Marketing Enablement Intern will help enable global marketing to be deployed for Japan and Australia.

You will bring greater visibility from You will build practical ways of working between central marketing teams and APAC, helping teams understand what is happening in each market, what needs to be adapted, and who is responsible for the next step. The role combines process design, planning, documentation, and cross-functional coordination.

This is not primarily a translation or task-execution role. Your goal will be to create repeatable systems that make collaboration with APAC easier and more effective.








YOUR MISSION (IF YOU ACCEPT IT): 🥇

 - Create and maintain shared calendars and documentation that give central and regional teams visibility on APAC activity, milestones, market adaptations, and open decisions.

 - Define a repeatable model for Australia to assess, adapt, and reuse relevant UK marketing initiatives.

 - Clarify what information, timelines, responsibilities, and decisions are needed before global initiatives can be rolled out in APAC.

 - Improve recurring request and handoff processes between central marketing teams and APAC.

 - Turn ambiguous information into clear workflows, templates, action plans, and operating documentation.

 - Work with Marketing Operations, the APAC marketing lead, and stakeholders across global marketing to ensure the agreed ways of working are adopted.




YOU ARE IN THE RIGHT PLACE IF: ⭐

 - You have native-level Japanese and are fluent in English.

 - You have created or improved a process, workflow, tracker, calendar, template, or documentation system.

 - You write clearly and can turn complex or incomplete information into structured next steps.

 - You can recognize when a global idea may need adaptation for Japan or Australia, and explain why.

 - You are organized, detail-oriented, and comfortable following through across multiple stakeholders.

 - You ask useful clarifying questions, identify missing context, and raise risks constructively.

 - You are interested in marketing operations, international collaboration, or improving how teams work together.



Previous marketing experience is welcome but not essential. We are interested in transferable experience from studies, student organizations, internships, projects, or other environments where you have built processes and coordinated work.






ABOUT THE INTERNSHIP:

 - Start date: January 2027

 - Duration : 6 months

 - Full-time internship (35h/week)

 - Location : Paris (France)
   
   


RECRUITMENT PROCESS: 📅

 - Skill fit interview and live case study with a team member (45min)

 - Video-call Interview with the Talent Acquisition Specialist (30 min)
   
   


WHY SHOULD YOU JOIN US ? ✌🏼

At Back Market, we’re committed to hiring and supporting diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives — it’s one of the reasons we’re such a high-scoring certified B Corp company (93.2).

No matter your role and seniority level, you’ll enjoy impact-driven work with hands-on career development in an innovative, driven, and fast-paced environment — with benefits to match, like:

- A mission driven work environment where your day to day makes an impact on the planet. Seriously.

- Hybrid work environment, with 2 remote days a week and 1 remote work week per quarter, plus 3 flex days.

- Employee Resource Groups, including mentorship programs, comprehensive accessibility policies, and cultural competency training.

At Back Market, we strive to create a workplace that embodies the world we’re trying to change. We’ve embedded our diversity, equity, and inclusion principles into our DNA — from dedicated staff to employee resource groups to our company values.

We know that the perfect background for a role doesn’t mean the perfect fit — we encourage you to apply for a role even if you think you may not have all the qualifications.

If reasonable accommodations are needed for the interview process, please do not hesitate to discuss this with the Talent Acquisition Team.

jobs.title: Summer Intern 2027 - Alan Summer Internship Program
jobs.desc:
HEALTH CAN’T WAIT. 

Not for symptoms to get worse. Not for a six‑month appointment. Not for a system to catch up. But that’s exactly how healthcare works today. You wait, until you can’t.

Alan exists to end the wait.

Health is a universal right, and we believe this right can only become real when it’s coupled with prevention. We need to stop treating health as something we repair and start treating it as something we build, every day. It’s not solely a question of willpower. It’s the healthcare system itself that needs to work for everyone, in a sustainable way.

So we are building the new standard in prevention insurance. Alan is the first company that integrates insurance, prevention, and care into a single, acclaimed user experience.

We are on an incredible journey to build a global leading company, with a unique culture https://alan.com/en/careers. We already partner with 40K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members, and have reached €800M+ in ARR.

Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 1000+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond.

📍 Paris, on-site 
🗓 Early June to end of August 2027 
🎓 Students (incl. Polytechnique 2nd-year internship)




⭐ THE PROGRAM ⭐

This summer, for the first time, Alan is bringing in a cohort of interns for a 3-month internship, from June to August. This program is for students whose curriculum includes a summer internship.

This is not a "watch and learn" internship. Past interns and Founders Associates have shipped work that teams still use after they left:

 - An AI tool searching the web for fake documents used in insurance fraud. The findings started a fraud-prevention pilot with a major French insurer.

 - An automated system approving simple medical claims in one of Alan's international markets, with no manual review.

 - An AI agent for sales reps. Cuts prep time before every prospect meeting with a personalized meeting brief and pitch.

 - A national health insurance bid. It led to a new local company and its first General Manager hire.

 - Launched a new insurance product, from the regulator application to in-app design and customer support. Took the product from idea to a regulator-ready launch.

 - A public AI healthcare hackathon co-hosted with Mistral. Brought together top AI builders, with €10K+ in prizes and credits for the winners.

This summer, it's your turn.




⭐ WHAT YOUR SUMMER LOOKS LIKE ⭐

 - Weeks 1 & 2 - team sprint: you build a shared project in a mixed squad with other interns. You meet several teams and see how Alan works as a whole.

 - June to August - your project: you’ll take full ownership of a project that drives real value, working inside a host team with clear goals and the freedom to decide how to reach them. At the end of August, you demo it to the company.

 - All summer - the program: talks and workshops with Alan leaders including the CEO/CTO, weekly coffee chats with Alaners, and a mentor who helps you grow.

You'll join one track, based on your interests, and the projects available across:

 - Engineering

 - Data & AI

 - Product

 - Design & Research

 - Marketing

 - Customer Care

 - IT & Operations

And more!




⭐ KEY OUTCOMES ⭐

By the end of August, you will have:

 - Shipped a project that a real team uses, and demoed it to the company

 - Built with AI, data and code on real problems: shipped AI agents, automations and analyses that go to production

 - Worked closely with senior Alaners and Alan's leadership

 - Met a cohort of sharp students from top schools in France and abroad

 - Gained a 360° view of how a fast-growing company works

Strong interns may be invited back to Alan after graduation, as a Founder Associate or full-time hire.




⭐ PROFILE & COMPETENCIES ⭐

 - You build. You code, or build seriously with AI tools, and you have something to show us: a tool, a prototype, a side project, a hackathon project.

 - You learn fast. You're comfortable owning a project that isn't fully defined yet, and you figure things out before asking someone to show you.

 - Analytical sense. You frame the right questions and break down problems clearly.

 - High agency. When something is broken, your first instinct is to fix it.

 - Clear writing. At Alan, we work in writing, in English. You need to be fluent.

 - Growth mindset. You ask for feedback and use it.

 - Available for 3 months, from June to end of August 2027.
   


⭐ THE PROCESS ⭐

We know you have other offers to weigh, so our process is designed to be efficient:

 1. Application (tell us about something you've built)

 2. A short call with the team to meet you

 3. A technical case

 4. Final fit interview

Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis.

International students welcome. If you apply through a university program (Princeton IIP, MIT MISTI, Penn GRIP, Waterloo Co-op), mention it in your application.




🙌 PERKS & BENEFITS

 - Competitive pay: €2,800 gross per month, well above the market rate for internships

 - All the tools you need: MacBook Pro, monitor, noise-cancelling headphones

 - A coach from day one: like every Alaner. Learn more about our coaching culture https://alan.com/en/blog/discover-alan/a/alan-culture-excellence-through-coaching.

If you identify yourself as a woman: did you know that research shows women often apply only when meeting 100% of requirements? Remember, this is just a guide, not a checklist.

jobs.title: Stage - Ingénieur.e SQA Python, banc de test physique - H/F
jobs.desc:
Chez Withings, nous souhaitons redonner aux individus le contrôle de leur santé.
Nous avons l'obsession de créer des produits beaux et intuitifs, afin que chacun puisse les utiliser facilement au quotidien; nos balances connectées, montres hybrides, tensiomètres, moniteurs de sommeil et tous les dispositifs de notre gamme sont aujourd'hui utilisés par des millions d'utilisateurs.
Notre objectif : permettre la prévention, le dépistage et l'accompagnement d'un certain nombre de maladies chroniques via des produits et des services innovants, afin de révolutionner la manière dont on prend soin de notre santé.

Intégré.e au sein de l'équipe SQA, vous prendrez en main un banc de test physique déjà en production : il valide chaque nuit l'installation, la mise à jour et la configuration d'une vingtaine de modèles de produits Withings (balances, montres, tensiomètres…), pilotés en UART et relais, intégrés à notre CI Jenkins. Ce stage a pour but de penser, concevoir et produire une version améliorée permettant d'automatiser les interactions physiques — prendre une mesure, monter sur une balance, porter une montre, appuyer sur un bouton, vérifier ce que l'écran du dispositif affiche — afin de convertir en tests automatiques (python) les cas de tests exécutés à la main.
En forte interaction avec la QA Firmware, vos principales responsabilités incluront :
- Automatiser les mesures simulables : injection de mesures en dblib côté firmware, synchronisation réelle, vérification dans l'app.
- Explorer l'émulation de device : étudier et prototyper la simulation complète d'un produit sur Raspberry Pi (comportement BLE/Wi-Fi, cycle d'installation, génération de mesures)
- Étendre la couverture du banc existant : nouveaux modèles de produits, nouveaux scénarios (installation, firmware, synchronisation)
- Concevoir, modéliser et réaliser les jig de tests : impression 3D de supports et d'actionneurs, pilotage de relais et d'instrumentation série, lecture de l'état des dispositifs (écran, LED).
- Développer et maintenir les scripts d'automatisation en Python (Appium, pytest) qui orchestrent app mobile (iOS et Android), backend et instrumentation physique.
- Intégrer chaque nouveau scénario à la CI Jenkins pour qu'il tourne chaque nuit, et mesurer la réduction du volume de tests manuels qu'il permet.
- Travailler avec les outils d'aujourd'hui : l'équipe développe avec un harness d'agents de code (Claude Code…) — pipeline de génération de tests, revues assistées ; vous l'utiliserez et contribuerez à l'améliorer.
- Analyser les résultats, remonter les bugs et documenter les composants hardware et software ; participer aux revues de code.

Requirements

• Vous êtes étudiant.e en dernière année d'une formation Bac+5 (école d'ingénieur ou université) et recherchez un stage de fin d'études ;
• Une excellente maîtrise de Python est indispensable, notamment pour l'automatisation et l'interfaçage avec le hardware (ex : pyserial) ;
• Des connaissances en conception mécanique et/ou en impression 3D (ex : FreeCAD, Fusion 360, Cura) seraient un atout majeur — le jig est autant mécanique que logiciel ;
• Des bases en électronique (schémas simples, capteurs, relais, UART) seraient un plus ;
• Une curiosité pour les agents de code (Claude Code, Codex…) est un plus ;
• Vous êtes à l'aise avec les environnements MacOS et Linux ;
• Vous êtes passionné.e par les produits high-tech innovants, l'IoT et les enjeux de la qualité logicielle et hardware ;
• Vous êtes curieux.se, rigoureux.se, autonome, force de proposition et vous disposez d'une bonne capacité d'adaptation pour progresser dans un environnement en constante évolution ;
• Vous êtes à l'aise pour communiquer vos idées et travailler en équipe ;
• Vous maîtrisez l'anglais technique (lecture et écriture de code et de documentation).
Benefits
Rejoindre l’aventure Withings, c’est :

• Intégrer un des pionniers et leaders mondiaux de la santé connectée, plusieurs fois primé au Consumer Electronic Show
• Contribuer à des projets innovants et ambitieux pour la santé de demain dans un environnement agile et en constante évolution
• Intégrer une entreprise internationale, membre de la FrenchTech 120, dont les équipes sont basées à Issy-les-Moulineaux, Boston, Hong-Kong et Shenzhen
• Participer à l’amélioration continue de nos produits et services en les bêta-testant avant leur sortie, notamment lors de nos nombreuses sessions sportives entre collègues
• Bénéficier de nombreux avantages : Stock Options, smartphone et ordinateur de votre choix, réductions pour des activités culturelles et sportives, restaurant d’entreprise, et bien plus encore
• Collaborer avec des collègues passionnés et célébrer ensemble chacune de nos réussites !

Toutes les candidatures reçues sont étudiées indépendamment de l’origine ethnique, des opinions, des croyances, de la religion, du genre, de l’orientation sexuelle ou de la santé des candidats. Withings aspire à offrir et garantir l’égalité des chances aux candidats et seules les personnes habilitées (RH et Management) auront accès aux informations concernant votre candidature.

• Intégrer un des pionniers et leaders mondiaux de la santé connectée, plusieurs fois primé au Consumer Electronic Show
• Contribuer à des projets innovants et ambitieux pour la santé de demain dans un environnement agile et en constante évolution

jobs.title: (Junior) CS Complaints Agent - German Speaking  (m/f/d)
jobs.desc:
Raisin is the world’s leading platform for savings and investment products. Founded in 2012, the FinTech connects consumers with banks in the EU, the UK and the US. This gives consumers better interest rates and banks a diversified form of refinancing. Our vision is to offer savings and investments without barriers and thus open up the global 160 trillion euro market.

Raisin currently employs more than 800 people from over 75 countries worldwide. Today, the platform holds over 80 billion euros in assets from more than one million investors which have accrued over 5 billion euros in returns.

Team

We are looking for a dedicated and competent professional to strengthen our team in the area of Solution Management EU, Customer Service. In this role, you will take on complaint handling, primarily for our German-speaking markets. Do you have a knack for de-escalation, work in a structured manner, and keep an overview even in challenging situations? If you want to drive complex cases forward in a solution-oriented manner and enjoy a constructive error culture, we look forward to receiving your application!

Your Responsibilities

• Complaint Management: You will handle customer complaints independently and on time. In doing so, you act in a solution-oriented and professional manner to ensure customer satisfaction even in difficult cases and a high-frequency environment.

• Root Cause Analysis & Optimization: You systematically analyze the reasons for complaints in order to identify operational weaknesses and initiate sustainable process improvements.

• Solution Orientation: You make well-founded decisions regarding goodwill arrangements within defined guidelines to achieve a fast and satisfactory solution for our customers.

• Quality Communication: You craft clear, empathetic, and comprehensive responses to complaints and ensure that every response is also regulatory compliant.

• Risk Assessment: You identify potential operational or legal risks at an early stage and support their minimization.

• Interface Management: You coordinate closely with internal departments (e.g., Product, Operations) to resolve complex issues quickly and in a customer-friendly manner.

Your Profile

• Completed training, ideally in banking or insurance, the legal field, or comparable areas.

• At least 1-2 years of experience in complaint management, customer service, or handling demanding customer inquiries – ideally in the financial services industry or a comparable regulatory environment.

• Strong understanding of de-escalation strategies as well as the ability to communicate complex issues in an understandable and solution-oriented manner.

• A strong ability to prioritize correctly even with high ticket volumes and to comply with Service Level Agreements (SLAs).

• A high sense of responsibility, teamwork skills, and a proactive approach to problem-solving.

• Minimum C1 fluency (written and spoken) in both English and German is required. Any additional language skills are a strong plus.

• Good IT skills (especially Google Workspace, Zendesk).

Join our mission, join our team – and grow with us!

At Raisin, we care about each other and it is one of our top priorities to foster an open and caring environment in which everyone feels welcome and comfortable. Our culture is strongly driven by our ambitious team, which connects more than 75 different nationalities.

As part of our team, you will benefit from:

• Employee Development Budget of €2,000 and four full training days per year.

• Flexible working hours, home office and 30 vacation days.

• A company pension scheme (Betriebliche Altersvorsorge), which we support with 20%.

• Enjoy more than 50+ different sports with Urban Sports Club: We subsidize your membership with more than €20 per month.

• Do you miss being in the office? The Deutschland Ticket gets you there, which we subsidize with €25 per month.

• Love cycling? With JobRad, lease the bike of your choice and enjoy tax savings, plus Raisin covers your monthly insurance costs.
