jobs.title: Praktikum Campaign Management (x/f/m)
jobs.desc:
GEMEINSAM GESTALTEN WIR DIE GESUNDHEITSVERSORGUNG DER ZUKUNFT

Doctolib sucht Dich ab Januar 2027 als Praktikant:in im Bereich Campaign Management für unseren Standort in Berlin.

Unser Team im Bereich Patient Solutions betreut gesponserte Präventionskampagnen auf Doctolib – immer mit dem Ziel, die Gesundheit aller zu verbessern. Die Onlinekampagnen behandeln Themen wie Rückengesundheit, Krebsvorsorge oder Angststörungen und richten sich an unsere 30 Millionen Nutzer:innen in Deutschland. Über die Doctolib Patient App sowie die mobilen und Desktop-Versionen erreichen wir sie genau in dem Moment, in dem sie sich mit ihrer Gesundheit beschäftigen. Unser Anspruch ist es, mit vertrauenswürdigen Informationen einen konkreten Beitrag zur Gesundheit zu leisten.


DEINE AUFGABEN

Als Praktikant:in unterstützt Du uns dabei in folgenden Aufgabenbereichen: 

 - Du trackst die Performance laufender Kampagnen und bereitest die Ergebnisse für unsere Kund:innen auf.

 - Du begleitest Kampagnen von der Vorbereitung über den Livegang bis zur Auswertung ihrer Performance.

 - Du bist Ansprechpartner:in für das operative Kampagnenmanagement.

 - Du arbeitest eng mit dem Sales-Team zusammen.

 - Du analysierst die Zufriedenheit unserer Kund:innen und identifizierst Optimierungspotenziale in der Umsetzung.

 - Du bringst Dich in die strategische Weiterentwicklung unserer Dashboards, insbesondere in Tableau, sowie unserer Prozesse ein.

 - Du arbeitest mit Tools wie Canva, K.I., WordPress etc.

Während Deiner Tätigkeit bei uns wirst Du:

 - umfassendes Wissen im Bereich Healthcare Marketing sammeln.

 - Kampagnen-KPIs und Kundenzufriedenheit messen, reporten und verbessern.

 - Deine Fähigkeiten in den Bereichen Kommunikation und Projektmanagement mit internen und externen Stakeholdern weiterentwickeln.


DEIN PROFIL

Du bist der festen Überzeugung, dass Du genau das mitbringst, was es für die Position braucht? Dann ermutigen wir Dich, Dich zu bewerben. Selbst wenn Du nicht jede Anforderung erfüllst, bist Du vielleicht genau die/der richtige zukünftige Doctoliber:in für diese oder andere Stellen!

Um Teil unseres Teams zu werden, bringst Du Folgendes mit:

 - Du studierst im Bereich Marketing, Kommunikation oder einem ähnlichen Bereich oder hast Dein Studium gerade abgeschlossen und stehst für ein 6-monatiges Praktikum zur Verfügung.

 - Du begeisterst Dich für digitales Marketing und Kampagnenmanagement und interessierst Dich für Gesundheitsthemen.

 - Du arbeitest gerne datenbasiert und zeichnest Dich durch eine strukturierte, proaktive Arbeitsweise sowie ein ausgeprägtes Auge fürs Detail aus.

 - Du verfügst über ausgezeichnete mündliche und schriftliche Kommunikationsfähigkeiten und hast Freude am Austausch mit Kund:innen.

jobs.title: (Junior) Customs Manager
jobs.desc:
Who we are

Helsing is a defence AI company. Our mission is to protect our democracies. We aim to achieve technological leadership, so that open societies can continue to make sovereign decisions and control their ethical standards.

As democracies, we believe we have a special responsibility to be thoughtful about the development and deployment of powerful technologies like AI. We take this responsibility seriously.

We are an ambitious and committed team of engineers, AI specialists and customer-facing programme managers. We are looking for mission-driven people to join our European teams – and apply their skills to solve the most complex and impactful problems. We embrace an open and transparent culture that welcomes healthy debates on the use of technology in defence, its benefits, and its ethical implications.

The role

As a (Junior) Customs Manager at Helsing, you will help shape and build our customs function from the ground up. You will manage our import and export operations, ensure full compliance with all customs regulations, and develop processes and guidelines. In this role, you will work closely with Export Control, Supply Chain, Procurement, Logistics, and Finance.

The day-to-day

•
Manage and monitor all import and export operations via external customs brokers and freight forwarders, including verifying customs declarations and documents for accuracy.

•
Select, instruct, and manage the performance of customs brokers, and conduct regular quality checks.

•
Prepare for, facilitate, and follow up on external audits and inquiries from customs authorities, acting as their primary point of contact.

•
Continuously monitor the requirements for Authorized Economic Operator (AEO) status, keep internal controls and documentation up to date, and support the application for or maintenance of the status.

•
Build a management system for supplier declarations and preferential origin from the ground up, including processes, system support, requesting and verifying declarations, and supplier communication.

•
Develop and implement internal customs guidelines, work instructions, and process descriptions, for example regarding tariff classification, customs valuation, origin, and customs procedures.

•
Train internal stakeholders and advise other departments on customs-related matters.

•
Identify opportunities for optimization, such as reducing customs costs, simplifying procedures, and driving digitalization.

•
Build and functionally lead a customs team in the future as the department grows

You should apply if you

•
Completed vocational training in freight forwarding and logistics (Speditionskaufmann/-frau) or a degree in Business Administration or Logistics, each combined with an additional qualification in customs (e.g., Certified Customs Specialist, Certificate in Customs Management)

•
3–5 years of professional experience in customs, ideally within an industrial company, at a customs broker, or in freight forwarding

•
Sound knowledge of the Union Customs Code (UCC), tariff classification, customs valuation, origin of goods and preferences, as well as customs procedures

•
Experience with AEO, customs audits, and supplier declarations

•
Strong assertiveness and confidence in representing positions toward internal stakeholders, service providers, and authorities

•
Ability to quickly adapt and thrive in new, dynamic environments

•
Structured, independent, and solution-oriented working style paired with a hands-on mentality

•
Keen interest in taking on leadership responsibilities in the future

•
Excellent written and spoken German and English skills

Note: We operate in an industry where women, as well as other minority groups, are systematically under-represented. We encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet all the listed qualifications; ability and impact cannot be summarised in a few bullet points.

Nice to Have

•
Experience with ATLAS/AES, SAP GTS, or comparable systems, as well as knowledge of export control regulations

Join Helsing and work with world-leading experts in their fields

•
Helsing’s work is important. You’ll be directly contributing to the protection of democratic countries while balancing both ethical and geopolitical concerns

•
The work is unique. We operate in a domain that has highly unusual technical requirements and constraints, and where robustness, safety, and ethical considerations are vital. You will face unique Engineering and AI challenges that make a meaningful impact in the world

•
Our work frequently takes us right up to the state of the art in technical innovation, be it reinforcement learning, distributed systems, generative AI, or deployment infrastructure. The defence industry is entering the most exciting phase of the technological development curve. Advances in our field of world are not incremental: Helsing is part of, and often leading, historic leaps forward

•
In our domain, success is a matter of order-of-magnitude improvements and novel capabilities. This means we take bets, aim high, and focus on big opportunities. Despite being a relatively young company, Helsing has already been selected for multiple significant government contracts

•
We actively encourage healthy, proactive, and diverse debate internally about what we do and how we choose to do it. Teams and individual engineers are trusted (and encouraged) to practise responsible autonomy and critical thinking, and to focus on outcomes, not conformity. At Helsing you will have a say in how we (and you!) work, the opportunity to engage on what does and doesn’t work, and to take ownership of aspects of our culture that you care deeply about

What we offer

•
Competitive salary and VSOP options

•
Relocation support: up to €2,500 and 4 weeks temporary accommodation

•
Learning: €500/£450 yearly allowance

•
Health & wellness: gym membership and mental health support (Nilo.health)

•
Social: regularly company events and monthly social allowances

•
Enhanced parental…

About the job
As a Manufacturing Sciences Intern, you will join our Manufacturing Sciences team within the laboratory at Sanofi Waterford, gaining hands-on experience in scientific investigations, laboratory testing and biopharmaceutical manufacturing processes.
You will work alongside experienced scientists, supporting projects involving complex biologics, including enzyme replacement therapies and monoclonal antibodies. This is an opportunity to explore new techniques, develop your problem-solving skills and contribute to scientific projects that support the development and improvement of manufacturing processes.
Ready to grow your skills while helping shape the future of healthcare? At Sanofi, you’ll be empowered to learn, ask questions, and bring your ideas to life – all while supported by inspiring mentors and collaborative teams.

Main responsibilities:

• Support day-to-day laboratory operations, including safety checks, chemical inventory management, sample handling and maintaining an organised working environment.
• Gain hands-on experience with laboratory techniques, including lyophilisation (freeze-drying) of biologics and protein characterisation.
• Assist with laboratory testing, scientific investigations and experimental activities under the guidance of experienced scientists.
• Support the planning, execution and documentation of technical studies, helping to analyse findings and explore potential solutions.
• Contribute to projects focused on improving manufacturing processes, introducing new products and supporting existing products throughout their lifecycle.
• Assist with laboratory equipment checks, documentation and maintaining accurate experimental records.
• Collaborate with team members to troubleshoot scientific challenges, share ideas and explore new approaches to laboratory work.

About you
To excel in this role you will need to have:

• Currently studying in the second or third year of a university degree in Biochemistry, Chemistry, Biology, Pharmaceutical Sciences, Biopharmaceutical Sciences or a related scientific discipline.
• A basic understanding of laboratory practices and scientific principles gained through your studies.
• A genuine interest in science, laboratory experimentation and learning new techniques.
• Strong attention to detail, curiosity and a willingness to approach challenges with a problem-solving mindset.
• Good communication and teamwork skills, with the confidence to ask questions, share ideas and seek guidance when needed.
• A proactive approach to learning, openness to feedback and willingness to take initiative as your knowledge develops.
• Basic proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, including Word, Excel and PowerPoint.

Previous industry experience is not required. We value your enthusiasm, curiosity and willingness to learn, and you will receive training and support throughout your internship.

About Sanofi
We’re an R&D-driven, AI-powered biopharma company committed to improving people’s lives and delivering compelling growth. Together, we chase the miracles of science to improve people’s lives.

Better is out there. Better medications, better outcomes, better science. But progress doesn’t happen without people – people from different backgrounds, in different locations, doing different roles, all united by one thing: a desire to make miracles happen. So, let’s be those people.

jobs.title: Junior Supply Chain Engineer - Operations (H/F)
jobs.desc:
Chez Withings, nous souhaitons redonner aux individus le contrôle de leur santé.
Nous avons l’obsession de créer des produits beaux et intuitifs, afin que chacun puisse les utiliser facilement au quotidien; nos balances connectées, montres hybrides, tensiomètres, moniteurs de sommeil et tous les dispositifs de notre gamme sont aujourd’hui utilisés par des millions d’utilisateurs.
Notre objectif : permettre la prévention, le dépistage et l’accompagnement d’un certain nombre de maladies chroniques via des produits et des services innovants, afin de révolutionner la manière dont on prend soin de notre santé.
Au sein de l'équipe Supply Chain basée à Issy-les-Moulineaux, nous recherchons un·e Junior Supply Chain Engineer – Opérations en CDI. Vous serez le point de contact de nos entrepôts en France et aux États-Unis, et le référent des opérations physiques : rework, reconditionnement, opérations à valeur ajoutée et retours B2B et B2C. En collaboration avec les équipes ADV, Planning, Qualité et Service Client, ainsi qu'avec nos collègues aux États-Unis et en Chine, vous veillerez à la fiabilisation de ces flux, à l'évaluation de leur performance et de leurs coûts.
Vos missions principales :
1. Entrepôts et stocks

• Être le point de contact de nos entrepôts en France, aux États-Unis et en Asie, et veiller au respect des process.
• Garantir la fiabilité des stocks : inventaires tournants et trimestriels, réconciliation 3PL / ERP, traitement du stock dormant.
• Mettre en place les opérations à valeur ajoutée : rework, kitting, personnalisation.
2. Retours et reconditionnement

• Gérer les retours B2B et B2C, et harmoniser les process entre l'Europe, les États-Unis et l'Asie.
• Piloter la chaîne de refurb (diagnostic, tests qualité, remise en stock) et le suivi des pièces détachées.
3. Performance et coûts

• Suivre les KPIs opérationnels (stocks, délais, retours, transporteurs) et produire le reporting mensuel.
• Analyser les coûts logistiques, contrôler la facturation des prestataires et identifier des leviers d'économie.
4. Automatisation et process

• Automatiser les flux de données avec nos prestataires (Python, API, Shopify Flow) et maintenir les tableaux de bord de l'équipe.
• Rédiger et tenir à jour les procédures opérationnelles (SOP).
Requirements

• Vous êtes titulaire d'un Bac +5 spécialisé dans la Supply ou issu d’une école d’ingénieur ou équivalent.
• Une première expérience (stage, alternance ou 0 à 2 ans) en logistique, entreposage ou opérations.
• Vous maîtrisez Excel, savez travailler avec SQL et analyser des bases de données ; des connaissances en Python sont un vrai atout.
• Vous connaissez le fonctionnement d'un ERP et d'un WMS, et vous êtes à l'aise avec les outils informatiques (Pack Office, Google Suite, IA).
• Anglais professionnel courant : vous travaillerez au quotidien avec des prestataires et des collègues en Europe, aux États-Unis et en Asie.
• Rigueur, proactivité, autonomie, sens de l'organisation et adaptabilité : vous êtes force de proposition et d'amélioration.
• Vous avez une aisance relationnelle pour faire avancer des sujets avec des partenaires externes et des équipes internes variées.
Benefits

• Rejoindre l’aventure Withings, c’est :

• Intégrer un des pionniers et leaders mondiaux de la santé connectée, plusieurs fois primé au Consumer Electronic Show
• Contribuer à des projets innovants et ambitieux pour la santé de demain dans un environnement agile et en constante évolution
• Intégrer une entreprise internationale, membre de la FrenchTech 120, dont les équipes sont basées à Issy-les-Moulineaux, Boston, Hong-Kong et Shenzhen
• Participer à l’amélioration continue de nos produits et services en les bêta-testant avant leur sortie, notamment lors de nos nombreuses sessions sportives entre collègues
• Bénéficier de nombreux avantages : Stock Options, smartphone et ordinateur de votre choix, réductions pour des activités culturelles et sportives, restaurant d’entreprise, et bien plus encore
• Participer à la Withings Med Academy en assistant à des conférences de professionnels de santé afin de renforcer ses connaissances dans le domaine médical
• Collaborer avec des collègues passionnés et célébrer ensemble chacune de nos réussites !

Toutes les candidatures reçues sont étudiées indépendamment de l’origine ethnique, des opinions, des croyances, de la religion, du genre, de l’orientation sexuelle ou de la santé des candidats. Withings aspire à offrir et garantir l’égalité des chances aux candidats et seules les personnes habilitées (RH et Management) auront accès aux informations concernant votre candidature.

jobs.title: Security Engineer Junior - GRC
jobs.desc:
HEALTH CAN’T WAIT. 

Not for symptoms to get worse. Not for a six‑month appointment. Not for a system to catch up. But that’s exactly how healthcare works today. You wait, until you can’t.

Alan exists to end the wait.

Health is a universal right, and we believe this right can only become real when it’s coupled with prevention. We need to stop treating health as something we repair and start treating it as something we build, every day. It’s not solely a question of willpower. It’s the healthcare system itself that needs to work for everyone, in a sustainable way.

So we are building the new standard in prevention insurance. Alan is the first company that integrates insurance, prevention, and care into a single, acclaimed user experience.

We are on an incredible journey to build a global leading company, with a unique culture https://alan.com/en/careers. We already partner with 40K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members, and have reached €800M+ in ARR.

Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 1000+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond.




🛡️ THE ROLE

Most GRC roles are about keeping auditors happy. This one is about earning our members' trust: every day, they share their diagnoses, their claims and their care with us.

You'll join Alan's security team to help run our compliance and risk work across ISO 27001, HDS and DORA, across a growing number of countries and regulators. We just earned our HDS certification, and there's much more to build, including how we govern AI across our products: assessing AI risks, setting the controls, and keeping up with the AI Act.

You'll learn alongside experienced security engineers, with a dedicated coach from day one. You'll take on real ownership early, and your scope grows as we scale from 1M to many millions of members. And you'll learn how we work at Alan: teams own their risks and controls, we automate wherever we can, and we focus on real outcomes, not paperwork.




🚀 WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Keep our certifications on track. You run the day-to-day of the ISO 27001 and HDS audit cycles: collecting evidence, preparing internal audits, and following up on corrective actions until they're closed.

 - Turn regulations into practical actions. With Legal and the DPO, you help translate requirements like DORA, HDS, and GDPR into clear tasks for the teams, and track that they get done.

 - Learn the health sector rules. You build your knowledge of health-specific frameworks (ANS, HDS) and help apply them to how we handle health data.

 - Contribute to risk management. You help build and update our risk mapping, including AI risks, and follow up on the treatment plans with the teams who own them.

 - Support the teams who own the controls. You keep the controls framework up to date, answer teams' questions, and help explain security clearly to every stakeholder, from engineers to managers.

 - Support incident governance. You help classify and document incidents, keep Business continuity and Disaster recovery plans up to date, and prepare inputs for DORA incident reports.

 - Automate what slows us down. You spot repetitive compliance tasks and automate them with scripts, tools or AI.




🏗️ WHAT YOU'LL HELP BUILD

 - One compliance backbone: A single control system for several regulators in several countries, so Alan can scale without rebuilding compliance each time.

 - An automated evidence engine: evidence collected straight from engineering systems with scripts and AI, so audits run continuously instead of as a quarterly rush.

You'll work closely with Legal, the DPO, Internal Audit and Risk, and day to day with engineering and operations teams.




⭐ WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - You want to do the work yourself and grow with it: a permanent, hands-on role where you build things for the long run.

 - 2+ years in security, GRC or compliance (an audit background is fine if you want to move into building).

 - You've played a key part in a certification or audit cycle (ISO 27001, HDS, SOC 2 or similar).

 - You're curious about how things work technically, and you've automated at least one manual task (a script, a tool, an AI workflow).

 - You're fluent in French and English, and comfortable presenting in both.

 - You learn fast, ask for feedback, and go into the details when it matters.
   
   


🌍 HOW WE WORK

Location: You must be legally eligible to work from France, Belgium or Spain.

Remote work: We offer remote work flexibility.

Contract type: Permanent contract only (no freelancing).




🎯 IMPORTANT NOTE: WE HIRE PEOPLE, NOT ROLES.

If you're excited about this opportunity but don't check every box, we'd love to hear from you. Everyone, no matter how underrepresented, should feel free to apply, as it can only bring learnings or success.

🔖 Check out our About Alan https://alan.com/about and Career https://alan.com/careers pages, as well as our Medium https://medium.com/alan, blog https://blog.alan.com/ and Glassdoor page https://www.glassdoor.com/Overview/Working-at-Alan-EI_IE1696043.11,15.htm for more info.




YOU WANT TO KNOW MORE ABOUT ALAN?

🙌 Perks & Benefits https://alan.com/en/careers/a/salary-equity: Alaners are provided with a stimulating environment and perks ensuring they are happy, efficient and spend only high-quality time with co-workers.

🤘A strong culture https://alan.com/en/about/a/leadership-principles: People joining Alan are often surprised and delighted by our innovative working method. We have a set of cultural values that guide our approach to work

jobs.title: Junior Medical Data Engineer
jobs.desc:
What if you could use AI to unlock valuable medical information hidden in thousands of documents and help turn it into insights that improve healthcare?
At SOPHiA GENETICS, we are building the future of AI-assisted, data-driven medicine. Our technology helps healthcare professionals make sense of complex data, with the ambition of improving outcomes for patients with cancer and rare diseases.
Every day, hospitals generate enormous amounts of valuable clinical information — diagnoses, treatments, biomarkers, imaging results and more. But much of this information remains locked inside PDF reports, making it difficult to analyze and use for research and innovation.
That's where you come in.
Join us for a six-month internship and explore how Large Language Models (LLMs) can transform unstructured medical reports into reliable, structured data that could support real-world evidence, clinical research and future AI applications.
What you'll work on:
You'll contribute to a real proof-of-concept project, exploring how different LLMs can extract clinical information accurately, efficiently and at scale.
Here's what that could look like:

• Create realistic synthetic medical reports. Generate synthetic PDF documents with known ground truth to safely develop and test AI models without using real patient data.
• Put LLMs to the test. Experiment with different models, prompting techniques and fine-tuning approaches to understand which perform best.
• Go beyond accuracy. Compare models based on reliability, robustness, processing speed and computational cost.
• Turn unstructured data into insights. Explore how extracted medical information can be organized into structured databases and connected across patient reports.
• Think about real-world applications. Depending on project progress, contribute to building a production-like workflow capable of processing incoming medical reports.
• Make your findings count. Document your work and share results and recommendations with technical colleagues and clinical stakeholders.
You'll get to work at the intersection of AI, data science, data engineering and healthcare, tackling challenges that matter beyond a research experiment.
Requirements
You might be studying Data Science, Artificial Intelligence, Computer Science, Data Engineering or a related field.
You'll probably enjoy this internship if:

• You're confident with Python. You have hands-on experience using Python for data processing, analysis, automation or machine learning projects.
• You know how to work with databases. You have a good understanding of SQL and experience querying, managing or structuring data in relational databases.
• You have experience with AI and LLMs. You're familiar with Large Language Models, their capabilities and limitations, and ideally have experimented with prompting, model evaluation or fine-tuning.
• You understand data engineering fundamentals. You're comfortable working with different data formats, building data-processing workflows and transforming unstructured information into structured datasets.
• You're curious about healthcare. You're interested in how AI can support clinical research and medical decision-making. Knowledge of medical data or healthcare terminology is a strong advantage.
• You enjoy solving complex problems. You have strong analytical skills, attention to detail and a rigorous approach to testing and validating results.
• You can work independently. You're comfortable taking ownership of a project, experimenting with different solutions and seeking feedback when needed.
• You communicate clearly. You can explain technical findings, model performance and trade-offs to colleagues from both technical and non-technical backgrounds.
You don't need to know everything about medical AI already. We're looking for someone who is curious, rigorous and excited to explore how emerging technologies can solve real problems.
Benefits
What you'll get as part of a team?
An internship at SOPHiA GENETICS is not about watching from the sidelines. From day one, you're part of the team.

• Work on a meaningful AI project, with the opportunity to contribute to the development of future healthcare technologies.
• Gain hands-on experience with LLM evaluation, fine-tuning, synthetic data generation and AI workflow development.
• Learn from experienced colleagues working at the intersection of AI, data science and healthcare.
• Build your professional network in an international environment and participate in company events and activities.
• Enjoy a monthly meal benefit and a paid internship according to our internship practices and degree level.
Duration: 6 months
All SOPHiA GENETICS internships and apprenticeships are paid according to each country's best practices and degree level.
Ready to put AI to work in healthcare?
Apply with your CV and any supporting information you'd like us to consider.
Bring your curiosity, challenge the models and help us explore how AI can turn complex medical data into meaningful insights.

jobs.desc:
Job Description:
Internship Private Bank – Client Lifecyle Management Team

Location: Luxembourg
Duration: 6 months
Start Date: 1 January 2027

For over 150 years, our dedication to being the Global Hausbank for our clients has been driven by our people - in around 60 countries and across more than 150 nationalities. Their deep understanding, insights, expertise and passion help our clients navigate an increasingly complex world – be it in our Corporate Bank, our Private Bank, our Investment Bank or our Asset Management division. If you are motivated to take initiative, collaborate with colleagues across the globe, and become part of a community where you can grow both professionally and personally, then join our team. Together, we can make a meaningful impact for our clients at home and abroad.

About the Internship Program

The Deutsche Bank Internship Program is designed to help you develop your skills through structured training, continuous support and hands-on experience. As part of the Private Bank Luxembourg Client Lifecyle Management Team, you will support to successfully onboard new clients, timely complete KYC reviews and accurately maintain client data as well establishing credibility and trust, maintaining the highest standards of personal and professional integrity.
You will gain first-hand insight into how we deliver services to clients worldwide, while building your professional network and learning from experienced colleagues across the business.

Role Overview

This internship offers an excellent opportunity for personal and professional development within a collaborative and international environment. You will support in onboarding, reviewing and maintaining static data of private banking clients

Key Responsibilities

• Support the Team in onboarding and KYC review process and follow up with the Front office teams
• Create and maintain client’s static data in core banking system
• Provide administrative and operational support to the Client Lifecyle Management Team
• Assist in the preparation of client documentation and reports
• Participate in the periodic projects with the objective to share the expertise and contribute to the new process efficiency

Requirements

• Business, Economics, Finance Student or Graduate (Bachelor, Master or Gap Year)
• Strong interest in financial services and Wealth Management
• Excellent communication and interpersonal skills
• Strong attention to detail and a high level of accuracy
• Ability to work effectively in a multicultural and international environment
• Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications and practical experience with AI tools
• Fluent in English written and spoken, additional languages are considered an advantage

• Proven ability to leverage AI tools to enhance productivity, optimise workflows to solve business problems, while applying critical judgment to ensure responsible and ethical use of data and AI outputs.

The successful candidate will be asked to present a recent criminal record

We strive for a culture in which we are empowered to excel together every day. This includes acting responsibly, thinking commercially, taking initiative and working collaboratively.
Together we share and celebrate the successes of our people. Together we are Deutsche Bank Group.

We welcome applications from all people and promote a positive, fair and inclusive work environment.

jobs.title: Praktikum Public Affairs & Advocacy (x/f/m)
jobs.desc:
GEMEINSAM GESTALTEN WIR DIE GESUNDHEITSVERSORGUNG DER ZUKUNFT

Doctolib sucht Dich ab dem 1. Januar 2027 als Praktikant:in im Bereich Public Affairs & Advocacy für unseren Standort in Berlin.

Unser Public Affairs Team arbeitet täglich daran, Doctolibs strategisches Netzwerk im deutschen Gesundheitswesen und in der Health-Tech-Branche auszubauen und zu pflegen. Als B-Corp-zertifiziertes Unternehmen stehen wir für mehr als nur technische Innovationen – wir sind Partner der Gesundheitsfachkräfte und gestalten gemeinsam die digitale Transformation des Gesundheitswesens. Durch den strategischen Austausch mit Interessengruppen wie Industriepartnern, Kassenärztlichen Vereinigungen und ärztlichen Berufsverbänden sowie die Positionierung auf relevanten Kongressen und Plattformen leisten wir einen aktiven Beitrag zur Verbesserung der Gesundheitsversorgung für alle.


DEINE AUFGABEN

Als Praktikant:in unterstützt Du uns dabei in folgenden Aufgabenbereichen:

 - Du führst Recherchen durch und bereitest Briefings sowie Präsentationen für Treffen mit externen Stakeholdern vor, zum Beispiel für Meetings, Branchenkongresse oder Paneldiskussionen.

 - Du begleitest uns auf Messen und Fachtagungen und nimmst an Gesprächen mit Vertreter:innen der Gesundheits- und Digitalbranche teil.

 - Du behältst den Überblick über die aktuelle Nachrichtenlage und filterst die für uns relevanten Inhalte heraus.

 - Du unterstützt uns bei der Organisation von Stakeholder-Events, Kongressen und anderen Formaten in der Gesundheitsbranche.

 - Du hilfst bei organisatorischen Aufgaben und der Koordination verschiedener Kommunikationsprojekte mit.


WÄHREND DEINER TÄTIGKEIT BEI UNS WIRST DU:

 - Die grundlegenden Tools und Methoden der Public-Affairs- und Advocacy-Arbeit in einem schnell wachsenden Tech-Unternehmen kennenlernen.

 - Umfassende Einblicke in die Funktionsweise eines cross-funktional arbeitenden Teams in einem agilen Umfeld erhalten.

 - Ein fundiertes Verständnis für Chancen und Herausforderungen bei der Digitalisierung des Gesundheitswesens entwickeln.


DEIN PROFIL

Du bist der festen Überzeugung, dass Du genau das mitbringst, was es für die Position braucht? Dann ermutigen wir Dich, Dich zu bewerben. Selbst wenn Du nicht jede Anforderung erfüllst, bist Du vielleicht genau die/der richtige zukünftige Doctoliber:in für diese oder andere Stellen!

Um Teil unseres Teams zu werden, bringst Du Folgendes mit:

 - Du studierst im Bereich Kommunikation, Politikwissenschaften, Gesundheitsmanagement oder einem anderen relevanten Bereich oder hast Dein Studium gerade abgeschlossen und stehst für einen Zeitraum von sechs Monaten zur Verfügung. Eine Immatrikulation ist für diese Ausschreibung nicht zwingend erforderlich; für ein Pflichtpraktikum ist ein entsprechender Nachweis notwendig.

 - Du hast großes Interesse an Themen rund um Digitalisierung und Gesundheitswesen und Freude an der Arbeit in einem schnelllebigen Umfeld.

 - Du hast Freude an der Erstellung von Präsentationen und anderen Kommunikationsformen und bist routiniert im Umgang mit GSuite beziehungsweise Google Workspace und MS Office, insbesondere Google Präsentationen oder PowerPoint.

 - Du arbeitest gerne im Team, bist strukturiert und proaktiv und verfügst über eine hervorragende Selbstorganisation.

 - Du verfügst über sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse (C2) und sehr gute Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift.


BESONDERS INTERESSANT SIND FÜR UNS AUSSERDEM:

 - Du zeigst Eigeninitiative und bringst kreative Ideen für die Stakeholder-Kommunikation ein.

 - Du verfügst über erste Erfahrungen in der politischen oder Unternehmenskommunikation.

 - Du hast bereits an Veranstaltungen oder Konferenzen im Gesundheitswesen teilgenommen.


WAS WIR DIR BIETEN

 - Ein strukturiertes und individuelles Onboarding im Rahmen unserer Doctolib Academy sowie ein breites Angebot interner Trainingsprogramme

 - Ein von Doctolib gesponsertes Deutschlandticket oder die Übernahme Deines Semestertickets

 - 28 Urlaubstage im Jahr (anteilig auf Deine Arbeitszeiten berechnet)

 - Ein flexibles Arbeitsmodell, das hybrides und Office-basiertes Arbeiten ermöglicht

 - Regelmäßige Frühstücksangebote im Büro sowie Bezuschussungen zu Deinem Lebensmitteleinkauf

 - Ein gefördertes Sportangebot mit unserem Partner Urban Sports Club


DER INTERVIEWPROZESS

 - Interview mit Deiner Hiring Managerin + kleine Präsentation (60 Minuten).

 - Optional: finales Interview (30 Minuten).


JOB DETAILS

 - Praktikum in Vollzeit (40 Std./Woche).

 - Tätigkeitsdauer: 6 Monate.

 - Arbeitsort: Berlin.

 - Praktikumsart: Pflicht- oder freiwilliges Praktikum möglich

 - Gehalt: 1.900 € brutto/Monat bei einem Pflichtpraktikum oder 2.545 € brutto/Monat bei einem freiwilligen Praktikum.

 - Startdatum: 01.01.2027

 - Arbeitsmodus: Hybrid (2–3 Tage Office/Woche).

Wir verfolgen die Vision, die Gesundheit aller zu verbessern. Dies spiegelt sich auch im Recruiting wider. Wir evaluieren Bewerbungen ausschließlich auf der Grundlage von Qualifikation und Motivation. Diskriminierung wird bei uns nicht toleriert.

Je diverser unser Team und die Ideen sind, desto mehr wird unser Produkt die Gesundheit unserer Nutzer:innen verbessern können. Deshalb laden wir dich ein, dich bei uns zu bewerben, unabhängig von Geschlecht, Religion, Alter, sexueller Orientierung, ethnischer Herkunft oder Behinderung. 

Um Chancengleichheit zu gewährleisten, kannst Du in deiner Bewerbung auf Angaben wie Fotos, Alter, etc. verzichten. Lass uns bitte wissen, welche Vorkehrungen wir treffen können, um Dich bestmöglich zu unterstützen. Wir freuen uns, mit Dir das Gesundheitswesen zu digitalisieren!

Alle bereitgestellten Informationen werden von Doctolib für das Bewerbungsmanagement verarbeitet. Für Details zur Datenverarbeitung klicke bitte hier https://doctolib.legal/B2C-Privacy-Policy-Career-DE. Bei Fragen oder wenn Du Deine Rechte wahrnehmen möchtest, wende Dich bitte an hr.dataprivacy(at)doctolib.com.

jobs.title: Software Engineering Intern - Fullstack (x/f/m) - Paris
jobs.desc:
SOFTWARE ENGINEERING INTERN - FULLSTACK (X/F/M)


SET A NEW PULSE FOR HEALTHCARE!

We are looking for a Software Engineering Intern to join the Engineering team.

Your mission will be to build innovative products and features that improve the daily lives of care teams and patients. You will work in a feature team developing solutions that directly impact healthcare professionals and patients across Europe, contributing to our Operating System powered by AI to manage all clinical and administrative activities.

Working in the tech team at Doctolib means building innovative products and features to improve the daily lives of care teams and patients.


WHAT YOU'LL DO

Your responsibilities include but are not limited to:

 - Build and own features alongside experienced engineers — from design and development to testing and shipping — with a direct impact on real users

 - Collaborate with engineers, product managers, and designers to solve complex technical challenges and build scalable, secure, and user-friendly healthcare tools

 - Write clean, efficient code following industry best practices in design, testing, and peer review

 - Solve real-world problems that directly enhance patient care and improve doctor-patient relationships

 - Explore new tools and technologies, including AI and distributed systems, as part of your continuous growth

 - Contribute to a culture of learning and collaboration by sharing knowledge and engaging actively with your team


WHO YOU ARE

Before you read on: if you don't have the exact profile described below, but you feel this job description matches your skill set, we still encourage you to apply.

You'll be a great fit if you:

 - You love problem-solving and are driven by curiosity — you're not afraid to dive into complex issues and find creative solutions

 - You thrive in a collaborative environment and enjoy working with cross-functional teams, sharing knowledge, and learning from your peers

 - You have a passion for technology and product development, and always keep the user experience in mind

 - You are comfortable coding, with the help of AI agents like Claude Code, in multiple languages and eager to learn our tech stack

 - You are in your final year of a degree in Software Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field and looking for a 6-month full-time internship

 - Eager to learn and work in a team of builders

 - You are fluent in English

It would be fantastic if you:

 - Have experience with web development or building products in a fast-paced environment

 - Have worked on side projects or contributed to open-source communities

 - Are familiar with AI-assisted coding tools and eager to integrate them into your daily workflow.


LIFE AT DOCTOLIB TECH

 - Our solutions are built on a single fully cloud-native platform that supports web and mobile app interfaces, multiple languages, and is adapted to country and healthcare specialty requirements.

 - Our stack is composed of Rails, TypeScript, Java, Python, Kotlin, Swift, and React Native.

 - We leverage AI ethically across our products to empower patients and health professionals. Discover our AI vision here https://careers.doctolib.com/ai-careers/.

Want to learn more about our tech culture and environment? Visit the Doctolib Tech site https://careers.doctolib.com/tech-doctolib/.


WHAT WE OFFER

 - Tech masterclasses throughout the internship

 - Free breakfast at the office

 - Access to the best AI tools for coding and development, along with dedicated training

 - Discounted membership to Urban Sports Club

 - Meal vouchers worth €8.50 per day, with €4.50 covered by Doctolib

 - 50% reimbursement of public transportation subscriptions

 - Comprehensive health insurance, fully covered by Doctolib for employees and their children under the basic plan

 - Free mental health and personalised coaching programme with our partner, Moka.care http://moka.care/

 - A comprehensive three-month onboarding programme, including Doctolib Academy and various training courses in languages, soft skills, and technical skills

 - A works council subsidy providing partial reimbursement for sports or leisure activity memberships

 - For employees with disabilities or caregiving responsibilities, a support package including adapted remote-working arrangements, paid authorised leave for medical appointments, and enhanced psychological support

Our interview process

 - Coding Game (1h)

 - Recruiter Interview (30 minutes)

 - Feature Building Interview (1h)

 - Behavioral Interview (1h)


JOB DETAILS

 - Internship (6 months)

 - Paris (Levallois)

 - Hybrid work setup (up to 2 remote days per week)

 - Start date: March 2027

 - Salary : 1500€ gross per month


WE WELCOME EVERYONE

At Doctolib, we are committed to improving access to healthcare for everyone. This translates into our recruitment process. We evaluate candidates based solely on qualifications and motivation, without any form of discrimination.

The more diverse ideas are heard, the more our product will truly improve healthcare for all. You are welcome to apply to Doctolib, regardless of your gender, religion, age, sexual orientation, ethnicity, or disability.

To ensure equal opportunities, we invite you to exclude personal information (e.g., pictures, age) from your applications. If you require any accommodation, please let us know for support during the hiring process.

Join us in building the healthcare we all dream of!


YOUR DATA PRIVACY

All information provided is processed by Doctolib for application management.

For data processing details, click here: Germany https://doctolib.legal/B2C-Privacy-Policy-Career-DE | France https://doctolib.legal/B2C-Privacy-Policy-Career-FR | Italy https://doctolib.legal/B2C-Privacy-Policy-Career-IT | Netherlands https://doctolib.legal/B2C-Privacy-Policy-Career-COM.

Please contact hr.dataprivacy(at)doctolib.com for inquiries or to exercise your rights.

Job title: internship 6 months – communication and project engagement

• Location: Paris 16ème arrt
• Starting : January 2027

About the job

As an intern within our digital team you’ll participate in increasing internal product visibility, awareness, and user engagement through effective communication and content initiatives. Ready to get started?

Ready to grow your skills while helping shape the future of healthcare? At Sanofi, you’ll be empowered to learn, ask questions, and bring your ideas to life – all while supported by inspiring mentors and collaborative teams.

About Sanofi:

We’re an R&D-driven, AI-powered biopharma company committed to improving people’s lives and delivering compelling growth. Our deep understanding of the immune system – and innovative pipeline – enables us to invent medicines and vaccines that treat and protect millions of people around the world. Together, we chase the miracles of science to improve people’s lives.

Main responsibilities:

• Participate in creating and publishing engaging content across internal social platforms and collaboration channels to increase product visibility and awareness
• Take part in monitoring engagement metrics, in gathering user feedback, and in optimizing communications based on user interactions and performance
• Support Product Owners in planning and coordinating internal communication campaigns and maintaining an active product presence
• Contribute to developing presentations and communication assets for leadership reviews, accelerator events, product showcases, and internal awareness initiatives
• Collaborate with Product Owners and gain exposure to digital product management, user engagement, and change management in a global environment

About you

• Soft and technical skills: adaptability, autonomy, proactivity. Experience in content creation and copywriting, proficient in Microsoft 365 Suite and AI tools, strong interest in digital products, innovation, and employee experience
• Education: Master’s degree in communication, marketing, digital communication or in management
• Languages: english fluent

Why choose us?

• Launch your career with a company that invests in you — and empowers you to reimagine what’s possible.
• Build your future with access to the latest tools, digital innovation, and continuous learning that keep you ahead of the curve.
• Grow in a purpose-driven company where your voice matters and your work helps improve millions of lives.
• Thrive in inclusive, flexible workplaces that support your personal and professional well-being.
• An attractive internship bonus.

• Depending on your location, access to a company restaurant with a contribution from Sanofi.

• Our recruitment process is designed to be fast and efficient. If your application is accepted, you will receive a call from our recruiter for an initial telephone interview, followed by a quick meeting with the manager.

Pursue Progress. Discover Extraordinary.
Join Sanofi and step into a new era of science - where your growth can be just as transformative as the work we do. We invest in you to reach further, think faster, and do what’s never-been-done-before. You’ll help push boundaries, challenge convention, and build smarter solutions that reach the communities we serve. Ready to chase the miracles of science and improve people’s lives? Let’s Pursue Progress and Discover Extraordinary – together.

At Sanofi, we provide equal opportunities to all regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, protected veteran status or other characteristics protected by law.

jobs.title: Banking, Corporate Banking, Placement Analyst Internship, Paris, France 2026
jobs.desc:
You’re ready to bring your knowledge from the classroom to the boardroom, and Citi wants to help you get there. Whether it’s honing your skills or building your network, we know that success can’t come without growth. Our programs equip you with the knowledge and training you need to play a valuable role on your team, and establish a long-term career here. At Citi, we value internal mobility, and career growth is not a question of if, but when. Citi is looking for Intern Analysts to join the Corporate Banking team in Paris, France in January 2026.

Corporate Bankers are relationship-focused finance professionals responsible for understanding the wide range of complex financial issues facing our clients around the world. Corporate Bankers drive the client dialogue on cash management, capital structure, liability management, liquidity and funding strategies, risk management, and investment solutions. Unique to Citi, Corporate Bankers are also responsible for credit allocation as well as relationship management. Corporate Bankers work in partnership with various Citi groups across the firm including Risk Management, Investment Banking, and the Capital Markets Origination. If none of these terms make sense right now, that’s ok! Our Internship is designed to help you increase your knowledge, so whatever your degree is in we will give you the training and support you need to excel.

We’re committed to teaching you the ropes. During the 6 months internship, you will be placed with a Corporate Banking team to work with for the duration of the Program. Top-performing Intern Analysts will return to Citi after graduation to work as a full-time Analyst.

Your time here will look something like this...

As an Intern, main tasks involve:

• Credit Analysis: Financial and operational analysis, including historical and projected performance of the clients

• Preparation of materials for Risk and Business approval committees: credit memos for annual reviews and episodic transactions (e.g. M&A, DCM, ECM, project finance, etc.)

• Bank’s credit exposure and capital management: Gather data through various Citi’s systems in order (1) to monitor bank’s exposure and profitability with its client, as well as (2) to produce concise analysis for the team

• Assistance in client relationship development and business origination: Research and presentation of potential relationship development in the field of numerous Citi’s products (e.g. IB, Capital Markets Origination, Treasury and Trade Services, Markets, etc.)

• Development of the banking relationship across Citi geographical network

• Support Bankers on ad hoc pitches (acquisition financing, capital market transactions…)

We want to hear from you if...

• You are available to start on January 2026

• You are currently enrolled in a University that can provide an internship agreement

• You a student status and related visa covering the whole internship period

• You have very good knowledge of Corporate Finance and Financial Markets

• You are fluent in English both written and oral (working language). Good level in French is recommended and additional languages beneficial but not essential

• You have advanced skills in PowerPoint, Excel and Word

Who we think will be a great fit...

A dedication to learning and a true passion for the business are vital. As industries all over the globe continue to restructure and grow, we are hiring professionals who have a global perspective on the future of banking and want to make an impact on the corporate level. We value diversity and so do you.

We’ll also be looking for the following:

• Commitment to personal growth and career development, a strong desire to learn and success in team environments

• Knowledge of the global or domestic business landscape is a plus, but not required • Strong communication, planning and organizational skills

• Desire to develop a deep understanding of the financial industry

• Unquestioned commitment to integrity ethical and decision-making

• Interest in business

We will recruit on a rolling basis and therefore encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

Before you apply have you visited our 'Career Inspiration Page'? Head over to learn more about life at Citi, ask a question or get handy tips from the previous Q&A.

Markets at Citi provides world-class solutions that are as sophisticated and diverse as the needs of the corporates, institutions, governments and individual investors we serve in 160 countries and territories. We work on trading floors in over 80 countries, enriching client relationships around the clock. The breadth and depth of our underwriting, structuring, securitisation, sales and trading and distribution capabilities span asset classes and currencies, sectors and industries. And our expertise covers a vast array of products including equities, commodities, credit, futures and foreign exchange (FX).

Your time here will look something like this

We're committed to teaching you the ropes. The Markets intern analyst program runs for six months starting in January 2027. Working alongside our experienced professionals, incoming analysts will have the opportunity to actively participate and develop their skills in areas such as rates, equities, commodities, credit, futures and FX. • We'll help you learn market making and trading book risk management.
• We'll offer you the opportunity to make a significant impact on the trading desk by developing pricing, hedging and analysis tools and strategies.

• We'll give you the opportunity to support key desk tasks like risk reconciliation, P&L, and trade booking – great for learning core operations.
• We’ll offer you the opportunity to contribute to quantitative research projects focused on identifying systematic trading strategies and improving existing risk models.
• We'll provide you with space to develop trade ideas, watch market trends, and improve analysis using Python and VBA to best identify parameter dislocations.

jobs.title: Communications Intern
jobs.desc:
Who we are

Helsing is a defence AI company. Our mission is to protect our democracies. We aim to achieve technological leadership, so that open societies can continue to make sovereign decisions and control their ethical standards.

As democracies, we believe we have a special responsibility to be thoughtful about the development and deployment of powerful technologies like AI. We take this responsibility seriously.

We are an ambitious and committed team of engineers, AI specialists and customer-facing programme managers. We are looking for mission-driven people to join our European teams – and apply their skills to solve the most complex and impactful problems. We embrace an open and transparent culture that welcomes healthy debates on the use of technology in defence, its benefits, and its ethical implications.

The role

As a Communications Intern based in Paris (starting January 2027 - ending in June 2027), you will support Helsing's communications and government affairs activity across France, with a particular focus on media monitoring, press logistics, and content production. You will help the team understand how Helsing is being discussed in the French press, keep media and stakeholder relationships organised, and ensure that internal and external communications materials are polished and on-brand. You will also play a dedicated role in preparing for and delivering Paris Air Show 2027, one of the most significant events on Helsing's calendar, working closely with colleagues across communications and government affairs to ensure it runs smoothly.

The day-to-day

•
Track and analyse French press coverage daily, flagging key narratives and sentiment shifts to the communications team

•
Coordinate logistics for press events and media engagements, from scheduling through to on-site execution

•
Draft and proofread internal updates, social copy, and briefing notes that reflect Helsing's tone of voice

•
Maintain and update a comprehensive media and stakeholder contact database to support outreach and relationship management

•
Provide logistical support for government affairs activities, including meeting coordination and roundtable and conference planning

•
Deliver dedicated support across all phases of Paris Air Show 2027, from pre-event planning through to on-the-ground execution

You should apply if you

•
Communicate fluently in French and English, both written and spoken

•
Write clear, concise copy tailored to different audiences and formats

•
Organise multiple moving parts simultaneously without losing attention to detail

•
Build and maintain relationships with media and stakeholder contacts

•
Adapt quickly to shifting priorities in a fast-paced environment

•
Approach ambiguous tasks with curiosity and a methodical mindset

Note: We operate in an industry where women, as well as other minority groups, are systematically under-represented. We encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet all the listed qualifications; ability and impact cannot be summarised in a few bullet points.

Join Helsing and work with world-leading experts in their fields

•
Helsing’s work is important. You’ll be directly contributing to the protection of democratic countries while balancing both ethical and geopolitical concerns

•
The work is unique. We operate in a domain that has highly unusual technical requirements and constraints, and where robustness, safety, and ethical considerations are vital. You will face unique Engineering and AI challenges that make a meaningful impact in the world

•
Our work frequently takes us right up to the state of the art in technical innovation, be it reinforcement learning, distributed systems, generative AI, or deployment infrastructure. The defence industry is entering the most exciting phase of the technological development curve. Advances in our field of world are not incremental: Helsing is part of, and often leading, historic leaps forward

•
In our domain, success is a matter of order-of-magnitude improvements and novel capabilities. This means we take bets, aim high, and focus on big opportunities. Despite being a relatively young company, Helsing has already been selected for multiple significant government contracts

•
We actively encourage healthy, proactive, and diverse debate internally about what we do and how we choose to do it. Teams and individual engineers are trusted (and encouraged) to practise responsible autonomy and critical thinking, and to focus on outcomes, not conformity. At Helsing you will have a say in how we (and you!) work, the opportunity to engage on what does and doesn’t work, and to take ownership of aspects of our culture that you care deeply about

What we offer

•
Ticket restaurant: Swile card, €9/day value, 50% employer-funded

•
Transport: 50% reimbursement of your transport subscription

Helsing is an equal opportunities employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, religion, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability or gender identity. Please do not submit personal data revealing racial or ethnic origin, political opinions, religious or philosophical beliefs, trade union membership, data concerning your health, or data concerning your sexual orientation.

Pour effectuer vos missions, vous interagirez avec l'ensemble des équipes produit cross countries : Product Managers, Product Marketing Managers et AI Trainers.


 

Vos missions

Vos responsabilités seront réparties sur deux grands axes :

Le cœur de métier (Run & Qualité des contenus) :

 - Rédiger des articles de FAQ de qualité en français et en anglais afin d’apporter des explications claires à nos utilisateurs sur le fonctionnement de nos produits.

jobs.title: Graduate Software Engineer
jobs.desc:
About Wayflyer

Today's small businesses need a capital provider that keeps pace with their growth ambitions. Traditional financing options are slow, cumbersome and often out of reach. That's why we built Wayflyer.

Our technology allows us to assess businesses in minutes, generate financing offers that reflect their growth potential, and send funds in as little as 24 hours. To date, we've deployed over $6bn to thousands of businesses worldwide, backed by Tier 1 banks like J.P. Morgan.

You'll be collaborating with ambitious colleagues from around the world. We have offices in Dublin, London, New York, Charlotte, Berlin and Sydney.

The challenge

Every founder who applies for funding moves through one connected system, from the data that assesses their business in minutes, to the product experience that makes getting funded feel effortless. As a graduate engineer, you won't just be handed a slice of that system to maintain. You'll get exposure to the whole thing: the data model, the API, the screen a founder trusts with their business, and the room to figure out where you want to go deep.

What you'll actually do

 - Own features end-to-end: work with product and design to shape solutions, build them, and ship to production, creating outcomes, not just closing tickets

 - Write clean, testable code with comprehensive unit and integration tests

 - Build new features that drive revenue and engagement, while keeping the lights on for what's already live

 - Participate in code reviews and contribute to technical documentation

 - Push technical discussions forward and raise the bar on quality, rather than waiting to be told what "good" looks like

Every feature you ship has a real person behind it, a founder waiting on funding, a brand trying to grow, so the way you build matters as much as what you build.

What this role could turn into

Engineers who bring this kind of ownership tend not to stay in one lane for long. Some grow into technical leads shaping how we build across teams. Others move into product-adjacent roles, working even closer with the businesses we serve. And some end up specialising deep into the systems and infrastructure that let us scale globally. Where you go depends on what you're curious about.

Who thrives here

You're a curious builder who gets genuine satisfaction from turning a messy idea into something people actually use. You ask questions before you assume, communicate clearly when something's not working, and take ownership without needing permission for every step. You're comfortable in ambiguity, you'd rather experiment and learn than wait for the perfect brief, and how you treat people matters to you as much as the code you ship.

We hire for range

 - A computer science background (or equivalent hands-on experience), with a solid grip on data structures, algorithms, and software design fundamentals

 - Comfort with Git and modern development workflows

 - Hands-on experience with Python, React (or similar), and SQL/relational databases

 - Bonus, not required: exposure to REST APIs, testing frameworks, CI/CD, cloud, or containerisation

We're less interested in ticking boxes on a CV and more interested in trajectory.

Location and working policy

Based in our Dublin HQ. Hybrid, 3-4 days onsite to start, transitioning to a more flexible remote role over time.
Please note we are hiring for a start date in June 2027.

The good stuff

25 days annual leave plus public holidays, private healthcare, life insurance and critical illness cover, a pension plan, generous parental leave, equity, and the option to work from abroad for up to 60 days a year.



By submitting your application, you acknowledge that Wayflyer Limited will process your personal data for the purpose of evaluating your suitability for the role. Such processing is based on the need to take steps prior to entering into a potential employment agreement. To learn more about how we handle your personal data, you can contact our privacy team at privacy@wayflyer.com or review our privacy notice at https://wayflyer.com/privacy-notice. https://wayflyer.com/privacy-notice.*

jobs.title: Security Engineer, New Grad
jobs.desc:
Who we are:

About Stripe
Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies - from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups - use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the team
Stripe offers an interesting middle ground between joining a small startup and going to work for a multinational company. We have systems and processes optimized for early-career professionals. You will be in an environment that prizes rigor, discipline, and reliability—from our products, from our ways of working, and from our colleagues. You will learn how the best teams put together extremely reliable systems, and you will be responsible for operating these systems, with adequate backup when things get tough.
The Security organization is dedicated to building and maintaining a secure financial infrastructure platform. By joining this team, you will be on the front lines, engineering solutions that protect the sensitive data and systems underpinning a huge portion of the world's economy. You will contribute to core security functions like threat detection and rapid incident response, building and scaling the platforms that manage vulnerabilities, and proactively performing offensive security assessments to identify weaknesses before they can be exploited. This is a chance to apply software engineering principles and new technologies such as AI to solve complex, high-stakes security challenges, ultimately ensuring that Stripe's mission to increase the GDP of the internet is achieved securely.

What you’ll do
As a Security Engineer New Grad you will have the opportunity to work across various security disciplines and own projects from start to finish. Your work will focus on securing Stripe's complex environment by applying software engineering principles to security challenges.

• You will learn and apply the principles of secure-by-default design by working closely with product and infrastructure engineering teams.

• You'll develop a foundational understanding of various security domains, such as threat detection, incident response, vulnerability management, or offensive security.

• You'll learn to act as a security subject matter expert, tailoring answers to both engineers and non-engineers.

• You'll contribute to the development of internal tools and automation to scale security efforts across Stripe.

• You will participate in threat modeling discussions, learning to balance security requirements with product advancement and user experience.

Responsibilities

• Work on cross-functional projects, directly collaborating with other engineers

• Give meaningful feedback on code reviews and technical designs

• Contribute to our overall security posture by continuously improving security processes, tooling, and defenses.

• Develop a deep understanding of Stripe’s security primitives, frameworks, and invariants.

• Provide actionable insights to help identify, prevent, detect, and respond to anomalous or potentially malicious activity.

Who you are:
We’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum requirements

• Currently enrolled in a Bachelor’s or Master’s program in Computer Science or related field (graduating by Summer 2026)

• Some experience and familiarity with programming, either through side projects or classwork. We work mostly in Java, Ruby, Python, JavaScript, Scala, and Go. We believe new programming languages can be learned if the fundamentals and general knowledge are present

• Basic knowledge of SQL or experience analyzing medium to large data sets.

• Exposure to cloud computing platforms such as AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud Platform.

• An adversarial mindset, understanding the goals, behaviors, and TTPs (tactics, techniques, and procedures) of threat actors.

jobs.title: Stage / Alternance - Key Account Marketplaces Intern (H/F)
jobs.desc:
Chez Withings, nous pensons qu’il est temps de redonner aux individus le contrôle de leur santé.
Nous avons l’obsession de créer des produits beaux et au design non intrusif, afin que chacun puisse les utiliser facilement dans son quotidien ; nos balances connectées, nos montres hybrides, nos tensiomètres et nos moniteurs de sommeil sont aujourd’hui utilisés par des millions d’utilisateurs.

jobs.title: Intern Talent Acquisition Coordinator (x/f/m)
jobs.desc:
Doctolib is looking for a Talent Acquisition Coordinator to join the Tech & Product Talent Acquisition team in our Berlin office. 

As a Coordinator, you'll focus on three essential areas: delivering exceptional candidate experience, mastering complex tech & product interview scheduling, and continuously improving our interview processes. In this role, you'll gain comprehensive insight into recruitment while applying your organisational and project management skills in a fast-paced, high-volume environment and developing advanced people skills through multi-stakeholder management. 


WHAT YOU’LL DO

As an intern, you will support us in the following areas:

 - Coordinate interviews between candidates, Hiring Managers and tech interviewers, ensuring a smooth candidate experience.

 - Send critical candidate communication during the recruitment process. 

 - Help maintain accurate candidate and interview information in our Applicant Tracking System.

 - Manage complex interviewer pools, candidate information and interview supporting materials.

 - Adapt and streamline the scheduling process to suit candidates and business needs.

 - Contribute to interview process design, track scheduling metrics (time to schedule, time to interview) and own your own projects with a focus on process improvement while leveraging AI and automation tools. 

 - Collaborate with Talent Acquisition Partners and Hiring Managers on Tech & Product recruitment end to end processes.


WORKING WITH US, YOU WILL LEARN:

 - How the full Talent Acquisition process works, from application to onboarding.

 - How to coordinate recruitment processes in an international technology environment.

 - How to work with an Applicant Tracking System and recruitment-related data.

 - How to collaborate with candidates, Hiring Managers and internal stakeholders.

 - How to contribute to a positive and inclusive candidate experience.

 - How Talent Acquisition supports the growth of Tech & Product teams.


WHO YOU ARE 

If you don't have the exact profile described below, but you feel this job description matches your skill set, we still encourage you to apply.


YOU COULD BE OUR NEXT TEAMMATE IF YOU:

 - Exceptional organizational skills, attention to detail, sense of urgency, and agility that enable you to stay on top of priorities and manage multiple tasks simultaneously.

 - Strong empathy that allows you to put yourself in other people's shoes and a genuine passion for finding solutions that work best for everyone.

 - A curious, problem-solving mindset with a willingness to learn and dig deeper to understand how operations and processes work.

 - Comfortable leveraging AI tools to streamline daily tasks, draft communications, and improve efficiency, with curiosity to keep learning new AI-powered ways of working.

 - Fluency in English with strong verbal and written communication skills, allowing you to adapt your expression to different audiences and situations.


NOW, IT WOULD BE FANTASTIC IF YOU:

 - Speak German at B2 level or above.

 - Have previous experience with an Applicant Tracking System, HR administration or coordination.

 - Have experience in an international, technology or fast-paced environment.


WHAT WE OFFER 

 - A structured and personalised onboarding programme through our Doctolib Academy, as well as a wide range of in-house training opportunities.

 - A flexible working model that allows for hybrid and office-based work.

 - A Deutschlandticket sponsored by Doctolib, or reimbursement of your semester ticket, subject to the applicable eligibility rules.

 - 28 vacation days per year, calculated pro rata according to your working schedule and internship duration.

 - Regular breakfast in the office and subsidies for your lunch or grocery shopping.

 - A subsidised sports programme with our partner Urban Sports Club.


THE INTERVIEW PROCESS

 - First call with Hiring Manager (30’)

 - Case study Interview (60’)


JOB DETAILS

 - Internship in full-time (40h/week).

 - Duration: 6 months.

 - Workplace: Berlin

 - Salary: €1,900 gross/month for a mandatory internship.

 - Salary: €2,425 gross/month for a voluntary internship; €2,545 gross/month from 1 January 2027

 - Start date: As soon as possible

 - Opportunity to work in a hybrid setup (3 office days/week).

 

At Doctolib, we are committed to improving access to healthcare for everyone. This translates into our recruitment process. We evaluate candidates based solely on qualifications and motivation, without any form of discrimination.

The more diverse ideas are heard, the more our product will truly improve healthcare for all. You are welcome to apply to Doctolib, regardless of your gender, religion, age, sexual orientation, ethnicity, disability.

To ensure equal opportunities, we invite you to exclude personal information (e.g. pictures, age) from your applications. If you require any accommodation, please let us know for support during the hiring process. 

Join us in building the healthcare we all dream of!

jobs.desc:
Chez Withings, nous souhaitons redonner aux individus le contrôle de leur santé.
Nous avons l’obsession de créer des produits beaux et intuitifs, afin que chacun puisse les utiliser facilement au quotidien; nos balances connectées, montres hybrides, tensiomètres, moniteurs de sommeil et tous les dispositifs de notre gamme sont aujourd’hui utilisés par des millions d’utilisateurs.

Rattaché(e) au Responsable Contrôle de Gestion, vous serez au cœur du pilotage de la performance et de la structuration de la donnée financière. Vous ferez le lien entre les équipes opérationnelles et la finance : analyser, fiabiliser et automatiser l'information pour aider les équipes à décider vite et bien, sur la performance commerciale comme sur les dépenses d'exploitation.
Au-delà du contrôle de gestion classique, vous contribuerez directement à nos chantiers data : construction d'une base CA/Marge unifiée et automatisation des reportings récurrents. Un vrai terrain de jeu pour un profil qui aime croiser finance et outils.

Missions
1. Analyse de la performance commerciale et du forecast

• Assurer l'analyse hebdomadaire des installations, du sell-out et des stocks distributeurs.
• Mettre à jour ces données dans notre outil de planification Anaplan et alerter sur les principales variations.
• Participer aux revues mensuelles de forecast avec les équipes commerciales pour analyser la cohérence et les écarts au budget.
2. Suivi de la performance opérationnelle et des OPEX

• Aider l'équipe finance à déployer le suivi des dépenses d'exploitation (OPEX) par service.
• Analyser et présenter les suivis OPEX aux responsables budgétaires, avec un vrai rôle d'alerte sur les dérives.
3. Automatisation et fiabilisation du reporting

• Contribuer à la construction et à la fiabilisation de notre base de données CA/Marge (réconciliation multi-sources SAP et e-commerce).
• Automatiser des reportings récurrents (Net Margin, OPEX, Flash Finance) via requêtes et outils dédiés.
• Participer aux analyses liées aux nouveaux flux : migration Shopify, partenariats B2B et nouveaux projets d'intégration.
4. Gestion des outils et analyses ad-hoc

• Assurer la collecte, la mise à jour et la fiabilité des données dans nos outils de pilotage.
• Réaliser des analyses ponctuelles pour les autres services : prévisions d'installations pour le service client, estimation des volumes des nouveaux produits, etc.
Requirements

• Étudiant(e) en école de commerce, d'ingénieur ou cursus finance / data, en césure ou en fin d'études, avec une première approche du contrôle de gestion et un vrai intérêt pour la donnée.
• Excellente maîtrise d'Excel : formules avancées, TCD, modélisation.
• Appétence forte pour la data et l'automatisation. Des notions de SQL et / ou Python sont un vrai plus et pourront être développées pendant le stage.
• La connaissance d'Anaplan et/ou SAP est un atout.
• Organisé(e) et rigoureux(se), vous gérez plusieurs sujets en parallèle.
• Autonome et curieux(se), vous prenez des initiatives et apprenez vite.

jobs.title: Werkstudent Customer Success (x/f/m)
jobs.desc:
GEMEINSAM GESTALTEN WIR DIE GESUNDHEITSVERSORGUNG DER ZUKUNFT

Doctolib sucht Dich ab sofort als Werkstudent:in im Bereich Customer Success für unseren Standort in Berlin. 

Das Customer Success Team bei Doctolib ist verantwortlich für die allgemeine Kundenzufriedenheit und eine langfristig erfolgreiche Zusammenarbeit mit kleinen bis mittelgroßen Praxen. Wir begleiten unsere Kund:innen im Alltag, unterstützen sie bei der optimalen Nutzung unserer digitalen Lösungen und stehen ihnen bei Fragen oder Herausforderungen zuverlässig zur Seite. Wir tragen dazu bei, dass Praxen das volle Potenzial von Doctolib ausschöpfen können und so gemeinsam mit uns die Zukunft des Gesundheitswesens gestalten.


DEINE AUFGABEN

Als Werkstudent:in unterstützt Du uns dabei in folgenden Aufgabenbereichen: 

 - Du koordinierst interne Aufgaben, indem du eingehende Anfragen auf das Team verteilst und für einen guten Informationsfluss sorgst

 - Du stehst im direkten Kontakt mit unseren Kund:innen – sowohl schriftlich als auch telefonisch – bearbeitest deren Anliegen, begleitest strukturelle Änderungen und informierst proaktiv über Produktneuheiten oder zusätzliche Angebote

 - Du unterstützt das Team und die Teamleitung bei administrativen Prozessen und sorgst dafür, dass der Arbeitsalltag reibungslos läuft

 - Du bringst dich aktiv in Projekte zur internen Prozessoptimierung ein und unterstützt bei der Dokumentation sowie Aufbereitung von Lerninhalten für das Team


WÄHREND DEINER TÄTIGKEIT BEI UNS WIRST DU LERNEN:

 - Den Aufbau einer Customer Success Organisation kennenlernen und Verständnis für die Customer Journey von Kunden im SaaS-Umfeld entwickeln

 - Lernen, Prozesse zu analysieren und fundierte Kenntnisse im Umgang mit der Bearbeitung von Tickets im CRM-System Salesforce erwerben

 - Verständnis entwickeln, wie nachhaltige Kundenbeziehungen aufgebaut und Kundenzufriedenheit langfristig gesichert werden


DEIN PROFIL

Du bist der festen Überzeugung, dass Du genau das mitbringst, was es für die Position braucht? Dann ermutigen wir Dich, Dich zu bewerben. Selbst wenn Du nicht jede Anforderung erfüllst, bist Du vielleicht genau die/der richtige zukünftige Doctoliber:in für diese oder andere Stellen!

 - Du bist in Vollzeit an einer Hochschule immatrikuliert

 - Du interessierst Dich für den Bereich Digitalisierung, insbesondere im Gesundheitswesen, und bringst Deine kommunikative Art gerne in der Zusammenarbeit mit Kunden ein

 - Du hast Freude an administrativen Tätigkeiten, arbeitest gerne lösungs- und detailorientiert und bringst technische Affinität mit

 - Du verfügst über eine selbständige und proaktive Arbeitsweise und hast Spaß an der Zusammenarbeit im Team

 - Du verfügst über Deutschkenntnisse auf C1-Niveau sowie gute Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift


BESONDERS INTERESSANT SIND FÜR UNS AUSSERDEM:

 - Du hast bereits in der Kundenbetreuung  oder im Sales gearbeitet

 - Du hast bereits erste Erfahrung in einer SaaS Firma oder im Gesundheitswesen gesammelt


WAS WIR DIR BIETEN

 - Ein strukturiertes und individuelles Onboarding im Rahmen unserer Doctolib Academy sowie ein breites Angebot an internen Trainingsprogrammen

 - Ein von Doctolib gesponsertes Deutschlandticket oder die Übernahme Deines Semestertickets

 - 28 Urlaubstage im Jahr (anteilig auf Deine Arbeitszeiten berechnet)

 - Die Möglichkeit, 10 Tage im Jahr aus dem Ausland zu arbeiten (nach 6 Monaten)

 - Eine betriebliche Krankenversicherung mit vielen Zusatzleistungen und Bezuschussungen (nach 6 Monaten)

 - Ein flexibles Arbeitsmodell, das hybrides und Office-basiertes Arbeiten ermöglicht

 - Regelmäßige Frühstücksangebote im Büro sowie Bezuschussungen zu Deinem Lebensmitteleinkauf

 - Ein gefördertes Sportangebot mit unserem Partner Urban Sports Club


DER INTERVIEW-PROZESS

 - Interview mit Deiner Managerin (60´) 

 - Offer


JOB DETAILS

 - Tätigkeit als Werkstudent:in (20 Std./Woche)

 - Tätigkeitsdauer: min. 1 Jahr

 - Arbeitsort: Berlin

 - Gehalt: 15 €/Std.

 - Startdatum: zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt
