jobs.title: (Junior) Customer Service Agent – Dutch Speaking (m/f/d)
jobs.desc:
Raisin is the world’s leading platform for savings and investment products. Founded in 2012, the FinTech connects consumers with banks in the EU, the UK and the US. This gives consumers better interest rates and banks a diversified form of refinancing. Our vision is to offer savings and investments without barriers and thus open up the global 160 trillion euro market.

Raisin currently employs more than 800 people from over 75 countries worldwide. Today, the platform holds over 80 billion euros in assets from more than one million investors which have accrued over 5 billion euros in returns.

Team

Are you an active listener, think in a solution-oriented way and really want to help customers?

Become part of our Customer Service team at Raisin - and support us as a Junior Customer Service Agent in providing our customers with a first-class experience. Our 1st level Customer Service team supports our Dutch-speaking customers mainly inbound by phone and email (in future also via live chat) with all matters relating to our financial products. For legal reasons, we are not allowed to provide investment advice, so our customer contacts focus on service, not sales.

If you want to develop your career and work in an internationally oriented FinTech company, we want to hear from you!

Your Responsibilities

• Quickly become an expert for our products and processes, you are the contact person for our customers.

• With your communication skills, you will independently handle customer inquiries by phone and in writing.

• You work closely with other colleagues from customer service and Raisin's departments and stakeholders.

• You inspire with your friendly manner and our customers feel in good hands with you, which contributes to customer enthusiasm.

• You professionally handle inquiries regarding the account opening and investment process up to basic tax issues.

• You contribute to making the use of our platform a positive customer experience.

• You develop and implement your own ideas for optimizing work processes.

Your Profile

• You speak Dutch at C2 level, both written and spoken and have a good command of English.

• Professional experience in customer service or customer support is desirable, regardless of industry.

• Strong communicators who want to help customers via telephone with words and deeds are also welcome.

• You enjoy dealing with people, you are able to handle several tasks simultaneously under pressure while setting appropriate priorities.

• You are interested in complex topics and in modern finance and capital markets.

• You have high expectations of your work and maintain an overview even in hectic times.

• You are confident using tools like Microsoft Office and Google Workspace and learn new systems quickly.

Join our mission, join our team – and grow with us!

At Raisin, we care about each other and it is one of our top priorities to foster an open and caring environment in which everyone feels welcome and comfortable. Our culture is strongly driven by our ambitious team, which connects more than 75 different nationalities.

As part of our team, you will benefit from:

• Employee Development Budget of €2,000 and four full training days per year.

• Flexible working hours, home office and 30 vacation days.

• A company pension scheme (Betriebliche Altersvorsorge), which we support with 20%.

• Enjoy more than 50+ different sports with Urban Sports Club: We subsidize your membership with more than €20 per month.

• Do you miss being in the office? The Deutschland Ticket gets you there, which we subsidize with €25 per month.

• Love cycling? With JobRad, lease the bike of your choice and enjoy tax savings, plus Raisin covers your monthly insurance costs.

• Hungry all the time? Snacks, daily fresh fruit as well as drinks provided at the office.

Raisin Applicant Privacy Policy

We value diversity and the unique experiences each individual brings. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every requirement, we still encourage you to apply.

We are an equal opportunity employer and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for everyone, regardless of race, colour, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, or gender identity.

jobs.title: Trade-in Buybulk Intern
jobs.desc:
HI, WE’RE BACK MARKET.

We’re here to help make tech reliable, affordable, and better than new. We're a global marketplace for refurbished devices, helping lower our collective environmental impact by providing trustworthy, affordable tech with 92% less carbon emissions than new.

Yep, you read that right. Turns out refurbished tech is way better for the planet than new. In fact, With every device purchased on Back Market, our positive impact on the planet grows. From our Customer Care representatives to our software engineer, every individual at Back Market cuts the planet — and consumers — a break. Our mission is simple: to do more with what we already have.

Are you ready to join us?

The Trade-In service enables customers to sell their old devices (smartphones, tablets, gaming consoles, Back Market’s network professional refurbishers. This is great for the consumer who can reclaim cash for their old device and prevent the accumulation of e-waste in our landfills. Trade-In is also a key pillar for Back Market as it facilitates the sourcing of tech devices to be refurbished and sold on our website.



BuyBulk is Back Market's centralized Trade-in service where a single professional processing partner receives, tests and grades all incoming devices on behalf of the refurbishers. Instead of each refurbisher individually sourcing and processing trade-in devices, BuyBulk handles the entire operational process and ships the tested devices in bulk. This service removes the sourcing burden and lets professionals focus on what they do best: refurbishing and selling.




YOUR MISSION (IF YOU ACCEPT IT): 🥇



Play a key role in ensuring Buybulk performance reaches targets on a daily / weekly / monthly basis by:

 - Tracking and monitoring KPIs to help the team understand performance drivers and take relevant actions: you will support the team in regular reporting, one-off analyses on specific topics and continuous improvement of reporting and tools

 - Being in charge of key operational processes and checks to ensure a steady performance and customer satisfaction



Support the team on major projects  - examples of projects and topics you could work on:

 - Improving efficiency through automation (simplify / automate processes, reportings, analyses, alerting …)

 - Build new or improve existing processes, tools and reports on ad-hoc projects (quality control, customer care, pricing, …)

 - Participate in structuring large projects by identifying opportunities (benchmark, research, …), setting up action plans, identifying stakeholders (within teams such business development, marketing or product), defining timelines and success factors and regularly following up on progress




YOU ARE IN THE RIGHT PLACE IF: ⭐

 - You are looking for a 6-month internship

 - English and French fluency (fully professional capability).

 - You have advanced analytical and data manipulation skills and exceptional attention to written, visual, and quantitative detail

 - You have advanced Gsheet skills (incl. pivot tables, complex formulas, …) ; you have basics of SQL - or willingness to learn during the internship ; VBA, Zapier and any automation or visualization tool/software is a big plus

 - You are eager to test and learn by yourself and to proactively identify areas of improvement and implement solutions

 - Ideally you have previous experience (internship, freelance, apprenticeship) as a business analyst, country or category manager, operations manager (logistics, customer care, …), seller success manager, investment banking or consulting intern/junior and you are looking for a hands-on experience allowing you to have a concrete impact on the business.




ABOUT THE INTERNSHIP:

 - Start date: January 2027

 - Duration : 6 months

 - Full-time internship (35h/week)

 - Location : Paris (France)




RECRUITMENT PROCESS: 📅

 - Business case (live) with a member of the team

 - Skills & cultural fit interview with the direct manager

 - Video-call Interview with the Talent Acquisition Specialist




WHY SHOULD YOU JOIN US ? ✌🏼

At Back Market, we’re committed to hiring and supporting diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives — it’s one of the reasons we’re such a high-scoring certified B Corp company (93.2).

No matter your role and seniority level, you’ll enjoy impact-driven work with hands-on career development in an innovative, driven, and fast-paced environment — with benefits to match, like:

- A mission driven work environment where your day to day makes an impact on the planet. Seriously.

 - Translate labels from English into German.

 - Map medical lists of terms across different products.

 - Select and filter terms, then validate your choices with medical experts.

 - Share your work and methodology with the Terminology and Ontology team and product teams.

 - Deliver sets of terms to technical teams in the correct format.

jobs.title: General Secretary Associate intern
jobs.desc:
HEALTH CAN’T WAIT. 

Not for symptoms to get worse. Not for a six‑month appointment. Not for a system to catch up. But that’s exactly how healthcare works today. You wait, until you can’t.

Alan exists to end the wait.

Health is a universal right, and we believe this right can only become real when it’s coupled with prevention. We need to stop treating health as something we repair and start treating it as something we build, every day. It’s not solely a question of willpower. It’s the healthcare system itself that needs to work for everyone, in a sustainable way.

So we are building the new standard in prevention insurance. Alan is the first company that integrates insurance, prevention, and care into a single, acclaimed user experience.

We are on an incredible journey to build a global leading company, with a unique culture https://alan.com/en/careers. We already partner with 40K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members, and have reached €800M+ in ARR.

Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 1000+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond.


⭐ GENERAL SECRETARY ASSOCIATE INTERNSHIP ⭐

The position is open for gap year or end-of-study interns with a starting date in March 2027, for a six-month internship. It is not open to MBA students.



 - The Associate supports the General Secretary on top business priorities, such as building new processes internally and externally.

 - This role offers a unique opportunity to work on a diverse range of projects in a dynamic and innovative environment.




⭐ DETAILED MISSIONS ⭐

The list below is not exhaustive as it will depend on the company priorities during your internship. However it gives a good overview of the range of topics and tasks.



Regular missions and recent projects

 - Sales & Business - Prepare meetings with external stakeholders, support in following up post meetings, track actions to conversion and maintain stakeholder momentum.

👉Help in the organization of events with investors and customers.


 - Corporate & Governance - Support research and projects related to regulatory stakeholders, fundraisings and governance matters.

👉Contribution to board pack preparation and management (content, timelines, Q&A); conduct targeted legal and market research.


 - Internal missions - Work on highly structural topics (salary grids, internal frameworks). Improve internal processes and cross-team coordination to ensure Alan can scale without compromising its core values.

👉Harmonization of the weekly internal communication



 - Brand & Communication - Strengthen the HR & Corporate presence at major events and on social channels, organise internal and external events to build the Alan network and systematize outreach and leverage connections globally.

👉End-to-end organization of events with top schools in our offices



 - Product & Technical topics - Support cross-functional projects through research, synthesis, and stakeholder coordination, turn insights into actionable recommendations for product and operations.



 - Talent - Sourcing and recruiting the next GS Associate.

👉Development of the hiring process for the next GS Associate





⭐ PROFILE & COMPETENCIES ⭐

Skills

 - Proactive & curious - You will be expected to deliver quickly and well on the tasks assigned to you, while to also always be going the extra-mile and show proactive thinking.

 - Analytical judgment and critical thinking - GS Associate produces a lot of research and analysis. This requires the ability to frame the right questions, evaluate and problem-solve including possible outcomes.

 - Versatility and stellar execution - You are comfortable with context switching while maintaining impact.

 - Organization and autonomy - You are well-served in missions requiring precision and reliability.

 - Crisp thinking and clear communication - You communicate effectively and concisely .

 - Step back - You have the ability to take a step back and understand the business needs related to any mission.

 - Technical appetite - Having an aptitude in or appetite for automation, AI and/or data analysis is a plus.



Languages

 - Fluency in spoken and written English.

 - Fluency in spoken and written French.



Background

We welcome applications from (at least M1 graduated) candidates with diverse educational backgrounds, including but not limited to:

 - Business schools (HEC, ESSEC, ESCP, LSE …)

 - Engineering schools (Polytechnique, Mines Paris, Ecole des Ponts, CentraleSupelec, Imperial … )

 - Law schools or political sciences/communication/HR masters in various  schools  (Science Po, Assas, La Sorbonne, Dauphine…)

 - Data science or mathematics programs Other relevant fields or schools (Bocconi, Politecnico, TU Delft, UCL, Oxford, Cambridge)



Diplomas matter to an extent but if you don’t have one and have built a project or a company, we’d love to hear from you so please send your application!




🙌   PERKS & BENEFITS https://alan.com/about/life-at-alan/a/perks

THEREFORE, WE OFFER:

jobs.title: User Research UX Apprentice
jobs.desc:
HI, WE’RE BACK MARKET.

We’re here to help make tech reliable, affordable, and better than new. We're a global marketplace for refurbished devices, helping lower our collective environmental impact by providing trustworthy, affordable tech with 92% less carbon emissions than new.

Yep, you read that right. Turns out refurbished tech is way better for the planet than new. In fact, With every device purchased on Back Market, our positive impact on the planet grows. From our Customer Care representatives to our software engineer, every individual at Back Market cuts the planet — and consumers — a break. Our mission is simple: to do more with what we already have.

Are you ready to join us?


JOB DESCRIPTION:

The User Research team’s mission is to help everybody at Back Market get to know and love our users  so that we can create great experiences for them. We gather insights about what users need through a range of qualitative and quantitative techniques and translate them into valuable information for the product and design team.

As an User Research (UX) Apprentice, you will work on the e-commerce experience Back Market provides to its customers, using insights to provide actionable recommendations for improvements, as well as contributing to improve our research processes, tools, and communications. You will also work closely with our business and product teams to ensure a user -centered culture in our problem and solution definition.




YOUR MISSION (IF YOU ACCEPT IT): 🥇

 - Bring stakeholders (business people), designers, product owners and engineers together to build, maintain, and evolve a robust experience for Back Market’s customers

 - Listen to business problems and helping craft action plans

 - Conduct qualitative research to collect insights and build strong recommendations

 - Launch quantitative studies to discover trends and validate the hypothesis

 - Work closely with product designers to ensure that your recommendations have the maximum impact

 - Present the results of your work to the company and make sure that the value of research is understood

 - Contribute to the development of the UX Research team with your colleagues




YOU ARE IN THE RIGHT PLACE IF: ⭐

Join us as a Regulatory Compliance Intern and help Qonto operate as a credit institution across Europe. You’ll advise teams on the regulatory requirements behind their projects as we go through our credit license transition. You’ll work under the guidance of Edouard, our Head of Regulatory Compliance, with Laura, our Regulatory Compliance Expert, as your mentor.



➡️ What you’ll do

 - Support payment and credit compliance: You’ll help analyse payment and credit rules to ensure compliance of new features, client claims, account suspensions and T&Cs changes to protect our customers.

 - Lend a hand on ad-hoc missions: You’ll support evolving priorities such as our credit license transition and jump in on 1–2 day missions for other regulatory sub-teams.

 - Legal comprehension: You can read legal texts from various European countries and grasp their core logic.

 - A mentor from day one: Laura will guide you throughout your internship.

 - A front-row seat: You’ll see up close how Qonto moves to credit institution status.

 - A team of 9: You’ll work with everyone on the team and join our biweekly team meetings.

You’ll report to Edouard Cahen https://www.linkedin.com/in/edouard-cahen-a48654109/, Head of Regulatory Compliance.  - Une première expérience en cabinet : 6 mois minimum avec du front-client, en alternance ou en poste. Tu connais le rythme des échéances et sais interagir en direct avec tes clients.

 - Appétence pour le digital et l'IA : Tu t'intéresses à ce que la technologie change dans le métier et tu veux travailler dans un cabinet qui en fait un avantage, pas un sujet de peur.

jobs.title: (Junior) CS Complaints Agent - German Speaking (m/f/d)
jobs.desc:
Raisin is the world’s leading platform for savings and investment products. Founded in 2012, the FinTech connects consumers with banks in the EU, the UK and the US. This gives consumers better interest rates and banks a diversified form of refinancing. Our vision is to offer savings and investments without barriers and thus open up the global 160 trillion euro market.

Raisin currently employs more than 800 people from over 75 countries worldwide. Today, the platform holds over 80 billion euros in assets from more than one million investors which have accrued over 5 billion euros in returns.

Team

We are looking for a dedicated and competent professional to strengthen our team in the area of Solution Management EU, Customer Service. In this role, you will take on complaint handling, primarily for our German-speaking markets. Do you have a knack for de-escalation, work in a structured manner, and keep an overview even in challenging situations? If you want to drive complex cases forward in a solution-oriented manner and enjoy a constructive error culture, we look forward to receiving your application!

Your Responsibilities

• Complaint Management: You will handle customer complaints independently and on time. In doing so, you act in a solution-oriented and professional manner to ensure customer satisfaction even in difficult cases and a high-frequency environment.

• Root Cause Analysis & Optimization: You systematically analyze the reasons for complaints in order to identify operational weaknesses and initiate sustainable process improvements.

• Solution Orientation: You make well-founded decisions regarding goodwill arrangements within defined guidelines to achieve a fast and satisfactory solution for our customers.

• Quality Communication: You craft clear, empathetic, and comprehensive responses to complaints and ensure that every response is also regulatory compliant.

• Risk Assessment: You identify potential operational or legal risks at an early stage and support their minimization.

• Interface Management: You coordinate closely with internal departments (e.g., Product, Operations) to resolve complex issues quickly and in a customer-friendly manner.

Your Profile

• Completed training, ideally in banking or insurance, the legal field, or comparable areas.

• At least 1-2 years of experience in complaint management, customer service, or handling demanding customer inquiries – ideally in the financial services industry or a comparable regulatory environment.

• Strong understanding of de-escalation strategies as well as the ability to communicate complex issues in an understandable and solution-oriented manner.

• A strong ability to prioritize correctly even with high ticket volumes and to comply with Service Level Agreements (SLAs).

• A high sense of responsibility, teamwork skills, and a proactive approach to problem-solving.

• Minimum C1 fluency (written and spoken) in both English and German is required. Any additional language skills are a strong plus.

• Good IT skills (especially Google Workspace, Zendesk).

Join our mission, join our team – and grow with us!

At Raisin, we care about each other and it is one of our top priorities to foster an open and caring environment in which everyone feels welcome and comfortable. Our culture is strongly driven by our ambitious team, which connects more than 75 different nationalities.

As part of our team, you will benefit from:

• Employee Development Budget of €2,000 and four full training days per year.

• Flexible working hours, home office and 30 vacation days.

• A company pension scheme (Betriebliche Altersvorsorge), which we support with 20%.

• Enjoy more than 50+ different sports with Urban Sports Club: We subsidize your membership with more than €20 per month.

• Do you miss being in the office? The Deutschland Ticket gets you there, which we subsidize with €25 per month.

• Love cycling? With JobRad, lease the bike of your choice and enjoy tax savings, plus Raisin covers your monthly insurance costs.

• Hungry all the time? Snacks, daily fresh fruit as well as drinks provided at the office.

• You are moving from another country or city to join us? We may support your relocation.

Raisin Applicant Privacy Policy

We value diversity and the unique experiences each individual brings. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every requirement, we still encourage you to apply.

We are an equal opportunity employer and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for everyone, regardless of race, colour, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, or gender identity.

As an Applied Science Intern, you will join a cross-functional team of engineers and applied scientists building AI-powered features within the Datadog platform. You'll also have opportunities to contribute to cutting-edge research that directly powers customer-facing features.

• Explore, analyze, and derive insights from the large-scale observability data flowing through Datadog systems

• Participate in technical knowledge sharing by presenting recent academic research and investigating emerging model architectures to improve existing and future products

• Collaborate with engineering and product teams to productionize AI solutions and deliver customer-facing features

• You communicate complex technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences

• You have a strong interest in artificial intelligence, machine learning, and data-driven product development

jobs.title: People Associate (internship)
jobs.desc:
HEALTH CAN’T WAIT. 

Not for symptoms to get worse. Not for a six‑month appointment. Not for a system to catch up. But that’s exactly how healthcare works today. You wait, until you can’t.

Alan exists to end the wait.

Health is a universal right, and we believe this right can only become real when it’s coupled with prevention. We need to stop treating health as something we repair and start treating it as something we build, every day. It’s not solely a question of willpower. It’s the healthcare system itself that needs to work for everyone, in a sustainable way.

So we are building the new standard in prevention insurance. Alan is the first company that integrates insurance, prevention, and care into a single, acclaimed user experience.

We are on an incredible journey to build a global leading company, with a unique culture https://alan.com/en/careers. We already partner with 40K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members, and have reached €800M+ in ARR.

Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 1000+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond.


WHAT YOU WILL DO

 - Employee experience — own the pre-boarding and onboarding operations end to end, and continuously improve the process so every new Alaner's first weeks feel smooth and well-supported.

 - People operations — get hands-on with the fundamentals of HR and be the first point of contact for Alaners navigating day-to-day requests.

 - Individual situations — shadow, then gradually own simple individual situations, learning how to guide leads and coaches through sensitive conversations with care and structure.

jobs.title: Software Engineer, New Grad
jobs.desc:
Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a technology company focused on improving the conditions for economic growth and prosperity. We build programmable financial infrastructure, rethinking from first principles how financial services should work, to make it easier and cheaper for any business to start and scale. More than 10 million businesses build on Stripe, spanning the economic frontier—from solo founders to established enterprises—united by a practical focus on growth. The most ambitious companies in the world use Stripe as core infrastructure to grow faster. They process trillions of dollars a year on Stripe, equivalent to around 1.6% of global GDP. While economic growth makes everyone better off, open markets also enable greater variety. When any business can easily serve a global customer base, the quality and diversity of products in the world increase, and craft and creativity are unleashed into the smallest niches. Our own growth is wholly contingent on the success of the businesses building on Stripe. We therefore invest back into our technology at an unusual rate. We make upgrades to our products every single day to deliver compounding gains to our customers. We maintain some of the most reliable APIs on the internet. We build entirely new pieces of financial infrastructure to enable new ideas. And our significant advances in risk and fraud infrastructure over many years are making the internet economy safer and more accessible.

Though people at Stripe don’t tend to take themselves seriously, Stripe is a fairly serious place: our customers are depending on us for their livelihoods. We admire ambition, intensity, curiosity, humility, and rigor. The most effective people become knowledgeable about many domains besides their own. Any company is an applied exercise in understanding some aspect of society or the market. In working with so many (especially the new and innovative ones), we think that Stripe is one of the very best places to learn about how the world works.

Your role

Stripe is large enough that individual products and projects can be rapidly deployed to a meaningful fraction of the world’s businesses, but small enough that individual agency still has outsized impact. Small teams can impact how millions of businesses grow. Right now the global economy is replatforming around AI, creating new opportunities for growth. We’re at the center of this, and we think the best work is still in front of us.

To meet this moment, we’re looking for people who move with urgency, like hard problems, and want their work to matter at a time of great change. If that’s you, there’s no better place to build your career.

Who you are

• Ambitious builder: You’re energized by building solutions without clear precedent and solving problems with far-reaching consequences. Successful Stripes are deeply curious, and prefer the joy of discovery to the comfort of certainty.

• Rigorous thinker: You appreciate that things worth doing are rarely simple. You enjoy working on problems that have never been tackled before.

• Adaptable problem solver: You adapt quickly and treat obstacles as opportunities. At Stripe we embrace kindness while encouraging Stripes to take measured risks and act boldly, even in the absence of consensus.

Minimum requirements

• A Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in computer science or a directly related field, obtained by summer 2027, or equivalent work experience; New grad candidates should have no more than 18 months of professional experience (excluding internship experience).

• Experience and familiarity with programming, either through side projects or classwork. We work mostly in Java, Ruby, JavaScript, Scala, and Go. We believe new programming languages can be learned if the fundamentals and general knowledge are present.

• Experience from either previous internships or working collaboratively on multi-person coding projects (in a university or professional setting).

• Ability to learn unfamiliar systems and form an understanding of those systems, through independent research and working with a mentor or subject matter experts.

• Clear written communication skills, with the ability to explain your work to stakeholders, team members, and other Stripes.

• Ability to leverage AI tools to accelerate development while applying rigorous critical thinking and professional judgement to review, refine, and validate all outputs.

Preferred qualifications

• One or more areas of specialized knowledge (frontend, backend, infrastructure or other technologies) balanced with general skills and knowledge.

• Experience in code review practices, and an understanding of how to safely update production systems.

• Familiarity with navigating and managing work in large code bases.

• Experience leading small projects independently, and contributing to larger projects alongside peers.

• Ability to operate with high agency in navigating complex technical obstacles independently, knowing precisely when to unblock oneself and when to ask for help.

About Us:

Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI, empowering organizations to analyze, design, and operate AI-driven processes. The Celonis Platform is powered by the Celonis Context Model, which combines process data, business knowledge, and intelligence to create a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can understand — turning AI’s operational blind spots into operational clarity. Industry-leading companies around the world trust Celonis and its global ecosystem of partners to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together, achieving transformational outcomes. Celonis is headquartered in Munich, Germany, and New York City, USA, with more than 20 offices worldwide.

Celonis Inclusion Statement:

At Celonis, we believe our people make us who we are and that “The Best Team Wins”. We know that the best teams are made up of people who bring different perspectives to the table. And when everyone feels included, able to speak up and knows their voice is heard - that's when creativity and innovation…

jobs.title: AI Research Intern (PhD) – 3D Computer Vision
jobs.desc:
Who we are

Helsing is a defence AI company. Our mission is to protect our democracies. We aim to achieve technological leadership, so that open societies can continue to make sovereign decisions and control their ethical standards.

As democracies, we believe we have a special responsibility to be thoughtful about the development and deployment of powerful technologies like AI. We take this responsibility seriously.

We are an ambitious and committed team of engineers, AI specialists and customer-facing programme managers. We are looking for mission-driven people to join our European teams – and apply their skills to solve the most complex and impactful problems. We embrace an open and transparent culture that welcomes healthy debates on the use of technology in defence, its benefits, and its ethical implications.

The role

As a PhD research intern in 3D computer vision, you will tackle open research problems in spatial perception and localisation, and explore how novel approaches can push the state of the art.

You will join our Spatial Intelligence Team, which builds systems for scene matching, geo-registration, simultaneous localisation and mapping (SLAM), visual-inertial odometry (VIO), and 3D reconstruction. You will investigate how the latest advances in the research community can add value to deployable systems, prototype the most promising ideas, and evaluate them rigorously under real-world data distributions and compute constraints.

You will work closely with a team distributed across Europe, alongside globally renowned AI experts, while collaborating with a broader team across Europe.

The day-to-day

•
Survey and critically assess state-of-the-art research in geometric computer vision, feature matching, place recognition, and SLAM/VIO.

•
Conceptualise how emerging techniques could apply to our localisation and reconstruction pipelines, and discuss trade-offs with the team.

•
Evaluate the strengths and weaknesses of different algorithmic approaches for concrete, mission-critical use cases.

•
Prototype and benchmark promising concepts against real-world operational conditions such as changes in illumination, viewpoint, season, or sensor modality.

•
Summarise findings in clear, concise written reports and present them to the team.

You should apply if you

•
Are currently pursuing a PhD in computer vision, machine learning, robotics, or a closely related field.

•
Have demonstrated theoretical and practical experience in localisation, scene matching, SLAM, visual odometry, or 3D reconstruction.

•
Are proficient in Python and experienced with AI frameworks such as PyTorch.

•
Have experience with Rust or C++.

•
Are able to work reliably and independently, and enjoy turning research ideas into working code.

Note: We operate at an intersection where women, as well as other minority groups, are systematically under-represented. We encourage you to apply even if you don't meet all the listed qualifications; ability and impact cannot be summarised in a few bullet points.

Nice to have

•
Published a paper, ideally on applied computer vision, at a top-tier conference or journal (e.g. CVPR, ICCV, ECCV, NeurIPS, ICLR, ICRA, IROS).

•
Experience with learned feature matching, place recognition, VIO, or neural 3D representations (e.g. NeRF, Gaussian Splatting).

•
Experience with model compression or domain adaptation for compute-constrained or edge deployment.

•
Experience with simulators, emulators, or synthetic data generation for geometry or localisation tasks.

Join Helsing and work with world-leading experts in their fields

•
Helsing’s work is important. You’ll be directly contributing to the protection of democratic countries while balancing both ethical and geopolitical concerns.

•
The work is unique. We operate in a domain that has highly unusual technical requirements and constraints, and where robustness, safety, and ethical considerations are vital. You will face unique Engineering and AI challenges that make a meaningful impact in the world.

•
Our work frequently takes us right up to the state of the art in technical innovation, be it reinforcement learning, distributed systems, generative AI, or deployment infrastructure. The defence industry is entering the most exciting phase of the technological development curve. Advances in our field of world are not incremental: Helsing is part of, and often leading, historic leaps forward.

jobs.title: Insurance Graduate Program
jobs.desc:
HEALTH CAN’T WAIT. 

Not for symptoms to get worse. Not for a six‑month appointment. Not for a system to catch up. But that’s exactly how healthcare works today. You wait, until you can’t.

Alan exists to end the wait.

Health is a universal right, and we believe this right can only become real when it’s coupled with prevention. We need to stop treating health as something we repair and start treating it as something we build, every day. It’s not solely a question of willpower. It’s the healthcare system itself that needs to work for everyone, in a sustainable way.

So we are building the new standard in prevention insurance. Alan is the first company that integrates insurance, prevention, and care into a single, acclaimed user experience.

We are on an incredible journey to build a global leading company, with a unique culture https://alan.com/en/careers. We already partner with 40K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members, and have reached €800M+ in ARR.

Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 1000+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond.




⭐️ THE ALAN INSURANCE GRADUATE PROGRAM ⭐️

The Alan Insurance Graduate Program is a unique opportunity to enter the team at the core of Alan Insurance business without getting silo-ed on a precise role. The Insurance team focuses on innovating on our health and disability insurance products, over 5 geographies including France, Belgium, Spain and Canada. Through the Program, you will develop a very precious blend of technical, business, entrepreneurial and product skills.

After a 2-months onboarding, you may be involved in multiple missions in different streams of the Insurance team:

 - The Enterprise and Public Sector stream structures the best offers for our largest clients, whether a ministry or a corporate. They land on our most important deals (RFP - request for proposal) with our Sales team, contributing to business growth in a very visible way. 

 - The insurance product stream dive into the lifecycle of a contract, from pricing and product implementation to the renewal phase. They team up with Engineer, Data and Marketing teams to ensure a delightful experience to our customers, whether when signing on our website, better equip Sales with the best offers or undergoing the renewal campaign (offer updates from one year to another). 

 - The analytics and repricing stream focus on building metrics, tools, and dynamic models to monitor our portfolio, forecast our margin and price our portfolio. They push strategic decision making (like repricing) alongside the Data, Strategy and Finance teams.

 - The reinsurance and risk stream owns the Capital requirement model, the risk governance, the relationship with our Supervisor (ACPR) and the reinsurance coverage. 

Each program and mission will be co-built with you, to make the most of your growth plan and ensure you have impact and visibility from day 1 at Alan. 

All along your Graduate Program, you will also benefit from a personalized support from the team through coaching. This will ensure that you are never alone on a topic and that you grow fast, while still being in the driver’s seat. 

At Alan, we are at the forefront of the latest innovations in artificial intelligence. You will be expected to leverage every piece of technology at your disposal to contribute to scaling our tooling and processes.




⭐️ IS IT YOU WE’RE LOOKING FOR? ⭐️

You would be a good fit if you:

 - Have a first experience in actuarial/insurance, finance, strategy, data, quantitative or product topics.

 - Have a scientific background (statistics, engineering, actuarial science) 

 - Are excited about growing in a fast-paced environment on multidisciplinary topics involving technical, data, regulatory, product and business questions related to health and prévoyance insurance

 - Are comfortable with SQL or willing to learn

 - Are analytical and structured, with a fact-based decision-making style

 - Are enthusiastic about teamwork, curious, learning, and teaching

 - Are willing to deeply change the insurance industry and challenge the status quo

 - Have strong written communication skills

 - Are fluent in both French and English (Alan’s working language)




🌍 HOW WE WORK

 - Location: You must be legally eligible to work from France.

 - Remote work: We offer remote work flexibility, but we value in-person collaboration
   
    


🎯 IMPORTANT NOTE: WE HIRE PEOPLE, NOT ROLES.

If you're excited about this opportunity but don't check every box, we'd love to hear from you. Everyone, no matter how underrepresented, should feel free to apply, as it can only bring learnings or success.

If you identify yourself as a woman: Did you know that research shows women often apply only when meeting 100% of requirements?

Remember, this is just a guide, not a checklist. We'll be thrilled to receive your application!
